apps.name: ComboBench

apps.name: ControllerMeta

apps.name: DashPanel

apps.name: DeckCrate

apps.name: ePaperCraft SHIRYU

apps.name: FaceTrack

apps.name: Galaxy Audio Visualizer

apps.name: Golden Goblin Player

Optional hardware support; a complete player without it.

apps.name: Heai: Virtual Companion

Early Access includes character appearance customization, Steam Workshop (mods for AI-powered interaction with him; creating and sharing custom clothing), Pomodoro sessions with him, and lo-fi music.

apps.name: HyperION DAW
apps.short_description: HyperION DAW is a modern Windows music production workstation with MIDI editing, VST3 plug-ins, procedural generators, mixing, mastering and a fast creative workflow.

apps.name: Keycast

apps.name: Live2DViewerEX

apps.name: Luditect: Game Design Tool

apps.name: Macro Mesh

Game servers for your group, a password vault, screen savers. One app instead of five, built by a gamer and steered by gamers.

apps.name: MPE Insight
apps.short_description: A real-time MIDI and MPE visualizer, MIDI monitor and MPE synth for any MIDI keyboard. See every note with its pressure, pitch bend and timbre as visuals, keys and live sheet music. Draw MPE notes, record MIDI, export video and audio. DRIFT adds MPE movement to an ordinary keyboard.

apps.name: MPE Keys
apps.short_description: A real-time MIDI keyboard and piano visualizer with a built-in MPE synth and live sheet music. Every note is drawn on the key itself: pressure as color, velocity as brightness, bend as a moving dot, timbre as rings. Scale Lock and chords on keys. No controller? Your computer keyboard plays it.

apps.name: Next Eye
apps.short_description: Control your PC directly from VR with intuitive gestures and simple interactions. Designed for people who spend hours in VR and don't want to remove their headset just to use their PC. Stay immersed, stay comfortable, and enjoy a smarter way to use your setup.

apps.name: Nvil

apps.name: Oeee Cafe

apps.name: OpenSheet 3.5e SRD

apps.name: PortalDesk
apps.short_description: Turn a cluttered desktop into a calm, organized workspace. Group icons into beautifully styled zones, open any folder as a live folder, and bring everything to the front with one shortcut. Lightweight, and a one-time purchase - no subscription.

apps.name: PortalVR Motion

apps.name: RPG in a Box

apps.name: Turbo Play

apps.name: Voice Notes

apps.short_description: Cleaner mic audio in one click, with less noise, less headset playback fed directly into your mic, and steady volume. For games, streams, and chat.

apps.name: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents Demo

Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

Every 20 seconds its priests read your cursor's trail as an omen: farm, build, trade, pray, study, or march to war. Lead them to the dawn of the Bronze Age.

apps.name: Danchi Days Demo
apps.short_description: Bring your hometown back together in a simple, story-driven adventure set in 2000s Japan! Reconnect with neighbors, surf the web and play minigames in a comedic-yet-bittersweet tale about a girl and her grandma living with Alzheimer's.

apps.name: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

apps.name: Day 31 Demo
apps.short_description: You're already infected. The suppressant is the only thing holding it back, and it runs out on Day 31. Fight through St. Harrow's Hospital wave by wave, trade nerve to a masked thing that calls itself a merchant, and try to see morning.

apps.name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift Demo
Deadpact Demo
apps.short_description: Sentenced to death, you're sent into the dark for one last chance at freedom. Solve interconnected puzzles, uncover secrets, face unique enemies with different behaviors, and make choices through dialogue. What you discover and decide will shape your story and determine how it ends.

apps.name: Deaduction Demo
apps.short_description: A multiplayer murder mystery blending horror, prop hunt, and supernatural powers. Work the night shift in a possessed hotel as an innocent staff member, a poltergeist controlling objects, or a body swapping doppelganger. Earn money to buy tools to uncover the imposters and survive the night shift.

apps.name: DEFY Demo
apps.short_description: Play the opening of DEFY's story from either side: the Meridian Concord or the Ashpact Horde. Ten training drills, the first three missions of each campaign, villages that hide or fight back, and a world worth fighting over.

apps.name: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard Demo
apps.short_description: The complete current build of DELVERS, free. Recruit a roster of hero classes, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot and named legendaries, grow a zodiac skill tree, and send a party of four into the depths to fight on their own. Haul the gold back, reach further. No caps, no timer.

apps.name: Demon Bluff Demo
apps.short_description: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

apps.name: Desktop Bug Killer Demo
apps.short_description: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

apps.name: Despiry Demo
apps.short_description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

apps.name: Desynced Demo
apps.short_description: Desynced is a sci-fi strategy game with fully customizable units and behaviors. Gather, build, research, and explore the unknown. Alone or with friends, unveil the mystery of an AI on the edge of self-awareness and uncover the hidden truth in this blend of strategy, automation, and exploration.

apps.name: Dicey Chess Demo
apps.short_description: A chess game in which the throw of the dice decides how far you can move.

apps.name: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale Demo
apps.short_description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

apps.name: Dinocop Demo
apps.short_description: In a world where dinosaurs and humans live side by side, you're the one and only Dinocop. And you got a meaty case to crack. In this mystery game set in a day cycle, uncover secrets scattered through time.

apps.name: DinoSwarm Demo
apps.short_description: DinoSwarm is a roguelite where you can hybridize Dinosaurs, fuse Powers and Elements, and more! The Swarm Queen is ready to invade the dimensions and gather as much DNA as she can. She will grant you incredible powers and enhancements. Invade Dimensions to collect DNA, Powers and Elements.

apps.name: Doomed Crew Demo
apps.short_description: Co-op Horror (1-4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?

apps.name: Dronefall Demo
apps.short_description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

apps.name: Drova - Forsaken Kin Demo
apps.short_description: Drova is an Action-RPG inspired by grim dark titles of the genre. Dive through a wall of everlasting fog to discover a society grown from the ashes of a dead empire. The demo offers around 2 hours of playtime.

apps.name: Dumbfire Demo
apps.short_description: Launch a missile and thread it through tight obstacles as fast as you can to take out the target. A physics time-attack flight game. Chase faster and more daring runs for more points. For fans of Superflight and Clustertruck.

apps.name: Dungeon Dot Ruby Demo
apps.short_description: Delve into the Master Dungeon as you explore the unyielding tunnels from a top-down view or hop and bop through expansive caverns in 2d-sidescrolling action! Rest assured, intense battles and big discoveries are to be found wherever you are in this retro-style adventure!

apps.name: DungeonVerse Demo
apps.short_description: DungeonVerse takes you to four unique worlds that have been reduced to gloomy dungeons by a catastrophe. Explore crumbling ruins, mystical places and forgotten cities, battle powerful bosses and collect all the artefacts to restore balance to your world.

apps.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket Demo
ECHIDNA Demo
apps.short_description: Strip the first two colossal dead titans cell by cell with a full drone/turret fleet, combo Cryo/Burn synergies, then duel each boss live. The full game adds 8 more monsters, deeper tech, remote outposts, and grows the Genome tree even further.

apps.name: Echoes of Elpis Demo
apps.short_description: Echoes of Elpis is a twin-stick shooter sci-fi roguelike. Upgrade weapons, discover new tech, and uncover a secret past as you battle through Elpis on an epic treasure hunt.

apps.name: Endacopia Demo
apps.short_description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

apps.name: EscapeFromSeoul Demo
apps.short_description: Explore two districts of a sealed-off Seoul in this single-player ASCII extraction survival demo. Fight, loot, upgrade your gear and hideout, and make it back alive. Import your demo progress into the full game.

apps.name: Esteem - A Saga of the Little Wolf Demo
apps.short_description: Esteem is an emotional RPG about Laisa, a young wolf cub who must confront her fears and insecurities to save her village. Explore a fantasy world where self-esteem influences battles and challenges. 2nd place in the Best Indie Game award at BGS 2024!

apps.name: European Deadzone: Polesie Demo
apps.short_description: The Polesie region of Eastern Europe lies quarantined after a catastrophic event transformed its landscape and inhabitants. As a lone survivor, navigate this sealed nightmare of succubi, ghouls, and twisted horrors. Uncover the truth or attempt to tame the unknown.

apps.name: Evoplasm Demo
apps.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

apps.name: EXCISA Demo
apps.short_description: Take a seat in the EXCISA demo. Choose a tarot card. Decide how many dice to roll. Advance the ritual toward the Angel while five uninvited guests may answer your call. Win the séance—and decide whether to stand up or stay seated.

apps.name: Extinction Force Demo
apps.short_description:
Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.
Enjoy the single player campaign or PVE with friends in co-op gameplay online, LAN and split-screen.

apps.name: FaceTrack Demo
apps.short_description: Capture facial animations via webcam, video, or audio files for your games, animations, VFX, and others creative works!

apps.name: Factory on a Train Demo
apps.short_description: Mine, craft and extend your Factory on a Train! As you find more resources and unlock increasingly complex recipes, your train grows and your production increases. Choose the right cars to face the challenges of the post-apocalyptic wasteland.

apps.name: Fat Chance Demo
apps.short_description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

apps.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club Demo
apps.short_description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom.

apps.name: Feed The Vessel Demo
apps.short_description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

apps.name: Feeding Gooble Demo
apps.short_description: Strap in to your chair and keep Gooble fed, or else! Combo foods, PROVIDE SYNERGY, and push your luck in this roguelite deckbuilder. Your demo progress rolls over to Early Access!

apps.name: Find The Needle Demo
apps.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

apps.name: FirstPlate Demo
apps.short_description: Run a restaurant under constant pressure in the FirstPlate Demo. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely, draft new menu cards in an endless survival challenge, and coordinate chaotic service solo or in co-op. Survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards!

apps.name: Flesh Grinding Demo
apps.short_description: Grind flesh, gather blood; Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

apps.name: FlipBAKA! Demo
apps.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch monsters—and friends—into the sea! This free demo includes Dungeon Mode through floor 6 with online co-op, up to four characters in Campaign Mode, and one PvP ruleset. Demo downloads are planned to end with Steam Next Fest.

apps.name: Forestless Demo
apps.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

apps.name: Forsaken Fleet Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

apps.name: Foundation Demo
apps.short_description: Foundation is a grid-less, laidback medieval city-building game with a focus on organic development, monument construction and resource management.

apps.name: Fox Stamps Demo
apps.short_description: Solve puzzles and collect stamps in the demo for this casual nonogram game!

apps.name: Free Ball Demo
apps.short_description: Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

apps.name: Fright Train Demo
apps.short_description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

apps.name: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare Demo
apps.short_description:
A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events.
War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

apps.name: Genius Simulator Demo
apps.short_description:
**Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!**

In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

apps.name: Get The Artifact: Violent Incursion Demo
apps.short_description: Take on a 60-second contract to retrieve a mysterious Artifact aboard a space station, or test your speed and precision across three short Time Attack runs. Master SuperSprint, Double Jump, and Back Flip, chase better times, and perfect every move. Every fraction of a second counts.

apps.name: Girlsnite - Anime Building Battle TPS Demo
apps.short_description: Girlsnite is a building battle TPS featuring both single-player and multiplayer modes. Choose your favorite anime girl from 4 unique default characters, including our poster girl "Shibu-chan"! Master your editing and building skills to dominate challenging CPU bots and rivals from around the world.

apps.name: GLANCED Demo
apps.short_description:
Step inside. Infiltrate the manor of porcelain dolls, some are maybe your friends. Steal the key from her cold neck, find the door, and whatever you do, don’t meet her eyes. One glance is enough to lose your body.
GLANCED: forget FPS shooters. Here, just a look...KILLS.
Now, just survive.

apps.name: Glasshouse Demo
apps.short_description: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

apps.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered Demo
apps.short_description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

apps.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

apps.name: Goldrot Demo
apps.short_description: A roguelite tower defense where every shot costs resources and every subject has needs of their own. Build production chains, manage your settlement, and keep your defenses supplied to survive increasingly dangerous Viking raids.

apps.name: Grandpa Golf Demo
apps.short_description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

apps.name: Granule Demo
apps.short_description: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

apps.name: Gravefever Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Gravefever. Punch, shoot and freeze your way through endless monster hordes, build your hunter from branching skills and capstones, and topple two mega bosses. Clear it as fast as you can and race the world on the demo leaderboards.

apps.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand Demo
apps.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 21 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

apps.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms Demo
apps.short_description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

apps.name: Green Mist over Portland Demo
apps.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

apps.name: Grimshire Demo
apps.short_description: A deadly plague threatens the village of Grimshire. Manage your farmland, forage the bounty of the wilds, prevent your harvest from rotting away and keep the root cellar full. Can you help bring the community together and survive?

apps.name: Groovekeeper Demo
apps.short_description: Your first shift at the record shop. 924 records just came in and the shelves are empty. Sort them by genre, put a rare one on the turntable and listen. The full shop opens October 30 with 5,260 records.

apps.name: HANDSUP Demo
apps.short_description: Escape a vertical nightmare with up to 4 friends using physics-based parkour. Equip Magic Rings to customize your climb. Don't let go, just keep your Hands Up.

apps.name: Happy Little Farm Demo
apps.short_description:
Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days.

However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

apps.name: Hellbinder: Shibari Secrets Demo
apps.short_description: Master Shibari, the authentic Japanese erotic art of rope bondage in this adult game! Play a demon tasked by an angel to perform sacred exorcisms on 8 customizable succubi. Featuring deep character customization and multiple game modes, can you subdue these seductive temptresses?

apps.name: Hillthorn Demo
apps.short_description:
A disappearance in a secluded mountain.
A village hiding its secrets.
A detective running out of time.

Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

apps.name: Hold Morale Demo
apps.short_description: Play the complete first world of Hold Morale: the Forest campaign with tutorial, every war map event, all 80 modules, and the world boss. A turn-based tactics roguelite where you combine retrofit kits into synergies and hold your army's morale.

apps.name: Horripilant Demo
apps.short_description: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. Horripilant is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.

apps.name: Hotel 13 Demo
apps.short_description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

apps.name: Hotel Stardust Demo
apps.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

apps.name: How To Destroy A City Demo
apps.short_description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

apps.name: How to Train Your Spirit: The Exorcism of a Busty Ghost Demo
apps.short_description:
Set in the Edo period, you are the last Onmyoji, called to an eerie estate for an exorcism.
The source is a lewd, busty female spirit.
As the final master of a forbidden art, your goal is to bring spirits to climax and purify them.
Yet this one feels different… a hidden truth lies beneath.

apps.name: Humani Project - Demo
apps.short_description: A story-driven, linear Metroidvania set 400 years after the Human-Robot wars of 199X. Hunted by machines and forced into pockets of semi-civilization, the remaining humans are being repurposed into living batteries. Will you be next?

apps.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust Demo
apps.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

apps.name: Hypnosis : Quiet Nights Demo
apps.short_description: Hypnosis: Quiet Nights DEMO is a psychological exploration game blending story-driven dialogue and 2D side-scrolling action. Help an insomniac girl sleep, battle cute yet dangerous dream monsters, and explore a journey through sleep, medication, and dreams. Includes the prologue.

apps.name: I Launch Demo
apps.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

apps.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing Demo
IJIN: History Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: A Bullet Heaven fought with history's great figures — this is the demo. One figure, one battlefield: survive fifteen minutes against the horde. You only move; attacks fire on their own. All you choose is the mix of weapons and passives. Record and gold carry into the full game.

apps.name: In The Black Demo
apps.short_description: Nuclear-powered space combat in the 23rd century! In The Black ™ is an intense, realistic space combat simulator with a serious respect for science. It is laser focused on the pilot experience and features single- and online multiplayer game modes, plus robust ship customization options.

apps.name: INNER EKO Demo
apps.short_description:
A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of.  

Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

apps.name: Inner Exile Demo
apps.short_description: Inner Exile is a cinematic FPS psychological horror experience told in a single uninterrupted take. Collect memory objects and solve environmental puzzles to rebuild a traumatic past inside a claustrophobic, mysterious mindscape.

apps.name: Into the Void Demo
apps.short_description: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

apps.name: IRONWAKE Demo
apps.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into a dormant Soviet industrial robot inside a sealed subterranean bunker. Navigate total darkness using stealth, solve environmental puzzles, and trust the voice on the radio. Uncover the clues and change how it ends.

apps.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey DEMO
apps.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

apps.name: It Happened At Night - A New Nightmare Demo
apps.short_description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

apps.name: It Has My Face Demo
apps.short_description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

apps.name: IT Specialist Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: IT Specialist Simulator demo puts you in the shoes of an IT pro. Fix computers, networks, and printers, manage daily tasks, and climb the tech career ladder—one click at a time!

apps.name: Just More Doors Demo
apps.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

apps.name: Just Weeding Demo
apps.short_description:
Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim.

Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

apps.name: Keep Making Games Demo
apps.short_description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

apps.name: Kick The Piñata! Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

apps.name: King's Haven Demo
apps.short_description: A combo-driven roguelike, where every Citizen is a card in your deck. Draft a Knight, Vampire, Rat King, Chef or over 100 other unique Citizens to chain together powerful synergies. Construct landmarks, survive seasonal threats and defend your Haven in this quirky roguelike deckbuilder.

apps.name: Kittycat Couture Demo
apps.short_description: Kittycat Couture is a cozy sandbox dress-up game about making outfits for cats. Style island residents, discover new designers, and fill your closet in this cozy game about appreciating fashion!

apps.name: Knightbane Demo
apps.short_description: Survive 12 minutes. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

apps.name: Kung Fu Addiction Demo
apps.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

apps.name: Lami: A Cup of Code And Coffee Demo
apps.short_description: Inherit your grandpa’s old café and meet Lami, an adorable robot girl! Craft gadgets, upgrade your café, serve customers, and face unexpected challenges as you uncover the story behind Lami.

apps.name: Last Signal Demo
apps.short_description: Plan the perfect infiltration. Route a stealth robot past patrols and cameras, hack terminals, operate machinery, and manipulate the environment to create your path. Then execute your plan and watch it play out. Every decision matters.

apps.name: Late Shift Demo
apps.short_description: Experience found-footage horror through the eyes of a missing cinema employee. Navigate a looping cinema, find anomalies, uncover the truth, and break the loop. Make sure every room is checked... thoroughly, or risk becoming another missing employee.

apps.name: Legend Dary Demo
apps.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

apps.name: Lens of Lust Demo
apps.short_description: Who said you can't mix profit with pleasure? Become a lewd photographer in this corny mix of visual novel and business management. Do you have what it takes to enchant the lens...?

apps.name: Leviathan: Rhino Demo
apps.short_description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

apps.name: Lexy Defense Demo
apps.short_description: Master legendary heroes in intense top-down combat while commanding strategic tower defenses. Control your champion directly, build and upgrade persistent towers that provide covering fire, then face powerful bosses and massive hordes. Use magic to empower your strategy and turn the tide of battle.

apps.name: Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow Demo
apps.short_description: We are candy chess pieces in a world made of sweets. Jump, solve, evolve — and learn real chess together.

apps.name: LimeFlesh Demo
apps.short_description: Humanity has melted into a massive, living mass of flesh. Born from a drop of blood at the bottom of this nightmare, you must push living walls, carve tunnels, and gather resources to escape. A short, tense body horror experience.

apps.name: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense (Demo)
apps.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

apps.name: Loot Tower Demo
apps.short_description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat!  Fight endless waves of monsters in this Rougelite Bullet Heaven with ARPG item progression.

apps.name: Loss Prevention Demo
apps.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

apps.name: Lost in the Desert with Giant Spiders Demo
Lost Mind Demo
apps.short_description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

apps.name: Love Exalt 8372 Demo
apps.short_description: A furry visual novel about a death game on a train. Read the minds of characters through minigames, choose which perspectives you want to see, and uncover the mysterious lore behind twelve unique characters.

apps.name: Love, Death & My Daughter Demo
apps.short_description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free short-form pixel-art narrative game. Walk through a rain-soaked cemetery, repair system faults, and sift through memories and files. Amid subtle horror and distortion, come to understand the love a mother left behind.

apps.name: Love: Fall in Death Demo
apps.short_description: An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices and timing shape the night. Try to impress Ayşil at the bar and navigate a branching story that can lead to love… or total chaos.

apps.name: Lunar Mining Demo
apps.short_description: Try Lunar Mining for free! Mine ores, upgrade your gear through the Forge and Skills tree, and push through the Surface biome up to level 15, all the way to your first boss fight against the Lunar Worm.

apps.name: Lustful Beauties: Forbidden Pleasures Demo
apps.short_description: Cute girls. Sexy outfits. Match-3.Yeah, you know where this is going.

apps.name: Lusty Tavern Rush Demo
apps.short_description: Inherit a gutted tavern and build it back. A first-person adult management sim where you pour ale, chase raised hands across a crowded floor, upgrade every room you own, and hire three women worth more than their wages.

apps.name: Mafia Hotel Demo
apps.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

apps.name: Main Sequence Demo
apps.short_description: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

apps.name: Make The Dead Dead Again Demo
apps.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

apps.name: Make the World Great Again Demo
Maker Circuit Demo
apps.short_description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

apps.name: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds Demo
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

apps.name: Mayday Airways Demo
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.

apps.name: Mechs V Kaijus 2 Demo
apps.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

apps.name: MeloDancer Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelike with rhythm-infused elements. The melody and pulse rising from the depths grant you strength, empower your choices. With every step, the darkness grows heavier and more enemies emerge from the shadows. Gather power, seek relics

apps.name: Meow Game Desert Island Survival Demo
Miner Survivor Demo
apps.short_description:
Mine. Build. Survive. Defend.
A fast-paced survivor defense game where you mine gold, build towers and drones, battle massive enemy hordes, and defeat powerful bosses in an ever-changing underground world.

apps.name: MOLOKAUST Demo
apps.short_description: Venture into a cursed town in this ruthless first-person survival horror game. With a hyper-realistic atmosphere and extreme survival mechanics, you'll need to ration your inventory and confront your worst nightmares to save your wife and daughter.

apps.name: Monkey Wave Demo
apps.short_description: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

apps.name: Monster Mavericks Demo
apps.short_description: Hunt mechanical monstrosities in a steampunk Wild West. Choose your loadout, gather a posse of up to four players, collect powerful upgrades and deploy combat drones as you explore dangerous frontiers and bring down notorious bosses.

apps.name: Morse Depths: WWII Demo
apps.short_description: Take command of a WWII submarine. Master Morse Code to fire torpedoes, defuse mines, and survive the final siege. From 1942 to 1945, every dot and dash is the difference between glory and the ocean floor.

apps.name: Multiworlds Demo
apps.short_description:
A world torn apart by one mistake, help pull it back into one.

A 2D puzzle game where you jump to different dimensions to put back a world you accidentally tore apart. But you control more than 1 player at a time.

apps.name: MURK Demo
apps.short_description: A bone wrenching blend of brutal melee and ranged combat. MURK is atmospheric combat horror in first person where you fight nightmarish creatures emerging from below. Survive against all odds in the vicious battle against the earth reclaiming itself.

apps.name: Murky Demo
apps.short_description: Murky is a zany artistic narrative adventure where you solve microgames, cast spells, and alter time to create new timelines as you attempt to rediscover your past in order to escape a world trapped in a three day cycle.

apps.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static Demo
My Helpers Demo
apps.short_description: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. FIND THEM by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

apps.name: Mysteries of the House (DEMO)
apps.short_description: You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move.

apps.name: Mystic Cleaver Demo
apps.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

apps.name: Mystical II : Les savoirs oubliés Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Mystical II: the filmed tutorial and the 10 stages of the Village. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows.

apps.name: MÁG Demo
apps.short_description: You're a mage with incredible powers and control. But you're fragile. Die and lose everything on you. Your skill is the only progression. If you're good, you don't need to grind, the money comes to you. One mistake and you lose it all.

apps.name: NAME OF THE WILL Demo
apps.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

apps.name: Narcissist Tail Demo
apps.short_description: You are a player who was called upon to help a strange wolf family escape. Figure out why they were kidnapped. Find hidden secrets with an in-game screenshot system. Battle monsters in bullet hell combat. But most importantly, find a way to out together.

apps.name: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid Demo
apps.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

apps.name: Necro Rising Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Necro Rising. Wake in a pauper's coffin, bind the fallen into a skeleton legion, call three villagers and the ranger Lin Yuan back from the grave, and hold Greywell's lamps through the night. Prologue and first two regions, about 40 minutes.

apps.name: Net Raiders - Demo
apps.short_description:
Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.
To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

apps.name: No More Turtles Demo
apps.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

apps.name: No Such Floor Demo
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a quiet hotel where routine tasks slowly turn into something far more unsettling. Clean rooms, help guests, manage the hotel, and explore strange events as the elevator begins taking you to floors that should not exist.

apps.name: Nordic Demo
apps.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends!  Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

apps.name: Norselings Demo
apps.short_description: Guide your Norse clan from Helheim to Asgard through runestone strikes and the rise of a Norseling settlement.

apps.name: Nulphia Demo
apps.short_description: A top-down action-adventure inspired by the classics. Master physics-based combat, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and explore a non-linear island full of magic and mystery. Download the free demo to play the entire first chapter!

apps.name: Oink Splash Party Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

apps.name: OKUREK Demo
apps.short_description:
Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars.
COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland.
Preserve what you couldn't save.

apps.name: One Hit Hero Demo
apps.short_description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.

apps.name: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story Demo
apps.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

apps.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike Demo
OverDoze Demo
apps.short_description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

apps.name: Overgrown Cleaner Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own restoration business as you trim, mow and clear overgrown spaces, craft tools from salvaged materials, and bring neglected places back into shape one project at a time.

apps.name: PactSworn Demo
apps.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

apps.name: Pathos Demo
apps.short_description: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.

apps.name: Paystreak Demo
apps.short_description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. The demo gives you the start of that journey. Work your way from pans and shovels to your first mechanized production chain. You get four seasons to prove you can run a gold mining company.

apps.name: Phonophobia Demo
apps.short_description: Awaken at an abandoned railway station in the Phonophobia Demo. Search for clues, solve tactile mechanical puzzles, and restore power to forgotten station. Every noise echoes with danger—survive the opening chapter.

apps.name: Pierrot Demo
apps.short_description: Pierrot is a first-person psychological horror set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others, Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends.

apps.name: Pistonica Demo
apps.short_description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

apps.name: Pixel Kitten Desktop Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy pixel desktop pet that brings companionship and comfort. It wanders around, curls up for naps, and gets hungry on its own — you can feed it, brush it, and watch it stretch and yawn beside you while you work. A quiet little companion that stays by your side while you study, work.

apps.name: Planet INC Demo
apps.short_description: Planet-colonizing deckbuilder roguelike! Contract with galactic megacorps for blueprints, drop onto uncharted worlds, and extract maximum profit. Harvest resources from alien terrains and creatures, skyrocket planetary value, and flip the world to the highest bidder!

apps.name: Planet No More Demo
apps.short_description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

apps.name: Please Handle Gently Demo
apps.short_description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

apps.name: Poolrooms Museum Demo
apps.short_description: Explore surreal liminal pool spaces and a strange waterless dungeon.

apps.name: Poolside Memory Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. This free demo lets you play the opening part of the game — the pool rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

apps.name: PRIEST Demo
apps.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

apps.name: Priority One Demo
apps.short_description: Demo For Priority One

apps.name: Prospice Demo
apps.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

apps.name: PuPuPoPu Company Demo
apps.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

apps.name: Purrfect Beats Demo
apps.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

apps.name: Puzzle Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

apps.name: Raid Sky Demo
apps.short_description: Fly your island, fish, craft, build cannons and unleash debuffs on bot rivals in 15-minute matches. Offline singleplayer only, Easy / Normal / Hard AI. Three ways to score: crystal charge, bonus zone and missions.

apps.name: Rebirth: Denied Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

apps.name: Red Echoes: Berlin Demo
apps.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

apps.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure where you attempt to re-establish a haven for the lost dwarven civilization. Journey across varied lands, help those in need, gather resources and fight off goblins and monsters as you slowly rebuild a home for your people.

apps.name: Rex Summons a Meteor Demo
apps.short_description: A short demo about a large rock. Help Rex accidentally summon a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the first island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play some absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in the first island of Rex Summons a Meteor.

apps.name: Rifles & Runes Demo
apps.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

apps.name: Ritual Break Demo
apps.short_description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes combine their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and face colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

apps.name: Road to Hollow Hills Demo
apps.short_description: Road To Hollow Hills is an adventure horror game. Explore the environment, collect useful resources, and customize the abilities of your character in order to survive the Road to Hollow Hills.

apps.name: Robo Dream Party Demo
apps.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler set inside a robot's dream, where physics goes haywire. Punch, grab, and throw anything you find, ride robot vehicles, and knock your friends off the map to be the last robot standing!

apps.name: RoboFarm Demo
apps.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

apps.name: RuneEra Demo
apps.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes, and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes, and dungeons.

apps.name: Save the Forest Demo
apps.short_description: Save the Forest is a tactics roguelite where you lead your squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Choose and create combos with over 25 units and 150+ skills!

apps.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! Demo
apps.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

apps.name: SchoolBoy Runaway Demo
apps.short_description: “You little rascal! Go do your homework!” said your parents and put you under house arrest. Try the demo version of the game, outsmart your parents, and find a way to have fun with your friends!

apps.name: Scratch The Cat Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

apps.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack Demo
apps.short_description: Free demo of Sekigahara 1600. The demo includes six battlefields: Nancy, Bowang, Okehazama, Sekigahara, Gettysburg and Waterloo, plus the interactive tutorial. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game.

apps.name: Shadow of the Road Demo
apps.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

apps.name: Shallow Pond Demo
apps.short_description: Explore a cozy slice of Shallow Pond as you swim, jump, and uncover secrets in this playful 3D platformer.

apps.name: Sheepscape Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Sheepscape, a cozy sim about one shepherd, one dog and a field full of sheep. Take a Welsh smallholding from five muddy sheep to a flock worth something: herd them, shear each fleece at its best, sell the wool, breed a better flock and earn the deed to your next farm.

apps.name: SHROOMY ISLAND Demo
apps.short_description: Shroomy Island is a desktop tower defense idle game. Critters automatically gather, craft, build, and patrol, help them run their village and fend off the evil mushroom monsters. Slowly expand and decorate your village, and collect different critters to keep you company while you work or study!

apps.name: Sinesperia Demo
apps.short_description: Someone lived a life here. You just can't remember it yet. Explore the dreams buried deep inside your mind to find out who you were.

apps.name: Skateboard Knight Demo
apps.short_description: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

apps.name: Skuffle Demo
apps.short_description: A split-screen and online party first person shooter. Mutator cards change how every round plays and theres a wide range of weapons to shoot your friends with. Maps are varied and range from small arenas to gimmicks and long distance battles. I think I gave you some of each of those. How generous.

apps.name: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike Demo
apps.short_description: Feature subset of Slimestronauts : Burst Strike!  A classic 'drop and match 4 color' game set in space with a variety of new ways to play!

apps.name: Sludgineers Demo
apps.short_description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

apps.name: Smawverse Demo
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy bullet heaven built in Unreal Engine 5. You are a stray cat reforged in iron: kneel to four prophets, stack their blessings until one cat clears the screen, survive streets laid out differently every run, and summon the different bosses to upgrade your spells and gear.

apps.name: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

apps.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs Demo
apps.short_description: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison. Rich story, choices with consequences, bureaucratic card battles, text-based soulslike.

apps.name: SoleRuler Demo
apps.short_description: You are a deity from the Heavenly Realm, and you will descend to the mortal world to fight across the three realms.

apps.name: Soul Tides Demo
apps.short_description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

apps.name: Soulstonia - Demo
apps.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

apps.name: SoundBoard Demo
apps.short_description: Community-built library: heart the sounds you love or add your own. Organize your way, customize categories, and set shortcuts as you like. The demo gives full SoundBoard access until launch—perfect for testing in calls, streams, and games.

apps.name: Sovereign Tower Demo
apps.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

apps.name: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes Demo
apps.short_description: A nonlinear pixel art visual novel set in the 1980s Soviet Union, inspired by Soviet children's spooky stories.

apps.name: SpecterMancer Demo
apps.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

apps.name: SpellChain Demo
apps.short_description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

apps.name: Spin Tactics Demo
apps.short_description: The full loop of Spin Tactics in one run: three encounters, then a boss. Everything on the board is yours to change, and what you build with what drops is the whole game.

apps.name: Spooky Market Demo
apps.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

apps.name: Spy Carnival Demo
apps.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

apps.name: Stack & Brew Demo
apps.short_description: Garden Gingdom is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

apps.name: Star Purr Demo
apps.short_description: A cute neon bullet-heaven roguelite. One cat, one catnip trip, ten thousand mice. Auto-fire weapons that mutate at Lv10 and Lv20, two bosses from the cat's dream, and a SSS combo to chase. Play the first chapter free — your wishlist unlocks the rest.

apps.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown Demo
apps.short_description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

apps.name: Starfinder: Afterlight Demo
apps.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

apps.name: Starlit World Demo
apps.short_description: Help Bo & Kikki save the Starlits from Oli’s evil spell in a cute and chaotic 3D platforming adventure! Discover special suits, fight bosses, and explore magical worlds as you rebuild Starlit Island and complete your sticker album!

apps.name: STILLTRACE Demo
apps.short_description: The first two days of the quarantine and eight waves of co-op. Repair the radio, scavenge supplies and hold the beacon under attack: alone, with a friend or with a bot partner. Your progress carries over to the full game.

apps.name: Stip Demo
apps.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets.  Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

apps.name: Strike Wings Demo
apps.short_description: A free demo of Strike Wings, inspired by the space shooters of the DOS era. Choose from seven ships, fly 17 battles and begin a voiced story campaign. Learn the ropes in Flight School, take on a 1v1 duel or team up in local split-screen co-op.

apps.name: Studio Zero Demo
apps.short_description: 《Studio Zero》is a first-person cyberpunk FMV thriller. In a future ruled by megacorporations, every choice you make dictates your fate. Will you shatter the system, become a corporate puppet, or vanish into the neon night? Step in—your choices shape the ending.

apps.name: SULFUR Demo
apps.short_description: This is the Demo of SULFUR - a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

apps.name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Open surprise eggs, collect cards and toy parts, raise birds, stock shelves, and serve customers. Discover shop management and collecting in this demo, with limited content compared to the full game.

apps.name: Supercar Collection Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Build your own diecast store! Unbox surprise car packs, expand your collection, and join thrilling races on racing tracks. A world of speed and excitement awaits in your store!

apps.name: Survindust Demo
apps.short_description: Play the free demo! Stranded on a tiny island in an endless ocean, you craft new land tile by tile, automate production and grow a bare camp into a self-sustaining industrial base.

apps.name: Swarmbreaker Demo
apps.short_description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

apps.name: Sword of Ace Demo
apps.short_description: A punishing 3rd-person soulslike action RPG set in a blood-soaked Gothic Horror Victorian world. Step into the armor of a final knight from the Sword of Ace Order, wield your iron sword against terrifying demonic hordes, and fight to survive the grim, mysterious remnants of a fallen civilization.

apps.name: TALLREAPER DEMO VERSION
apps.short_description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

apps.name: Tamer Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

apps.name: Tandem Together Demo
apps.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

apps.name: Tavernia Demo
apps.short_description: Try Tavernia free. A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

apps.name: Terraclysm Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 4 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

apps.name: The Artisan of Glimmith Demo
apps.short_description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

apps.name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire Demo
apps.short_description: Start from nothing and build a criminal empire in a seamless open-world sandbox. Run businesses, manage production chains, recruit your crew, fight rival families, and outsmart the police as every system pushes you closer to becoming the boss.

apps.name: The Dark West Demo
apps.short_description: The Dark West is a western occult ARPG set across a dying frontier that is consumed by corruption. Fight to survive with era-specific weapons and dark magic as you face deadly encounters and uncover distinctive items.

apps.name: The Devil's Due Demo
apps.short_description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

apps.name: The First Pixel Demo
apps.short_description: A single pixel wakes in the dark. Feed it, shape it, follow the patterns it leaves behind. Somewhere inside the noise are forgotten worlds, lost relics, and a question the pixel was never meant to ask.

apps.name: The Gallery: VR Secrets Demo
apps.short_description: Step Into The Gallery: VR Secrets! Immerse yourself in a VR art gallery where every painting holds a hidden puzzle.

apps.name: The Goblin Path Demo
apps.short_description: A single-player action RPG about a goblin serving the Demon King. Scout the next party at night, steal their gear, and prepare poisons and traps. By day, defend your lair and loot the heroes you defeat.

apps.name: The Golden Horde: Survival Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the world of the Golden Horde and experience its harsh medieval steppe. Gather resources, hunt, craft weapons, armor, and healing items, fight different enemies, and protect your yurt on wheels as you begin your journey.

apps.name: The Hearth and Harbour Demo
apps.short_description: This short experience introduces you to the world of The Hearth & Harbour by laying the groundwork for its story, establishing the setting of Lewthport, and acquainting you with some of its lively townspeople.

apps.name: The Inconvenience Store Demo
apps.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

apps.name: The King Got Too Much Gold Demo
apps.short_description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

apps.name: The Magic Garden 魔法花园 Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the  mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various   farming, collecting items, and using  items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

apps.name: The Melty Way Demo
apps.short_description: You move, you melt. You are a liquid-simulated slime where every move costs you a piece of yourself. Spend your mass to slide, shrink, and dash through pixel-perfect hazards in this challenging precision platformer where size management is critical and your only resource is your own body.

apps.name: The Missing Threads Demo
apps.short_description:
Who am I, without my memories?
Armed with nothing but the knowledge that I was once a detective,
I face the cases before me, piecing together fragments of truth—
deciding which leads to follow, which voices to trust,
and how quickly I can reach the answer.

apps.name: The RPG Demo
apps.short_description: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter. Play up to an hour with the demo, and explore the world of The RPG.

apps.name: The Soul of Cosmos（灵魂乾坤） Demo
The Swamp Daughter Demo
apps.short_description: Embark on Julia’s journey in this 2.5D eco-apocalyptic adventure of choices, exploration, and puzzles. Explore a dangerous swamp and face tough choices while you uncover her past in this intriguing tale of identity and survival.

apps.name: The Tower Must Fall Demo
apps.short_description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

apps.name: THE VIG Demo
apps.short_description:
You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear.
Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance?
This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

apps.name: The Wake (Demo)
apps.short_description: Set sail on the dark waters of a forgotten archipelago. Catch mutated monsters with customizable gear, master eldritch magic, and fight for survival. Take up arms to fend off sea beasts in an unforgiving Lovecraftian world.

apps.name: THORNSPELL Demo
apps.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

apps.name: THREADMILL Demo
apps.short_description: Write one program for every worker. Grow a robot workforce, share jobs and keep it working through changing supply and power outages. This Demo includes the opening Campaign, The Pipeline and replayable Challenges.

apps.name: Tia：weird hunter Demo
apps.short_description: This demo of Tia:weird hunter features Chapter One of the full experience. Dive into a hand-drawn 2D world, unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your skills. Explore the mysterious "Faceless City" and get a taste of the story, combat, and chaos still to come.

apps.name: Timberworks Demo
apps.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

apps.name: Time Jump Demo
apps.short_description: This is the Pre-Demo for TIME JUMP. Can you catch your other self? Want to know a little history of what happens before the actual story? Run run and run again in 3 short levels to catch the evil William Roger and put an end to his destruction.

apps.name: To Kill a God Demo
apps.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

apps.name: Too Many Orbs! Demo
apps.short_description: Restore a magical collection, one orb at a time. Explore an ornate hall, return scattered orbs to their shelves, reveal artwork, and unlock magical abilities. Choose what to restore in this relaxing first-person demo, with no timer and no rush.

apps.name: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria Demo
apps.short_description: Tower defense meets alchemy: Brew flasks, throw them at your enemies to counter their special abilities, or empower your towers with them. Defend Khaldoria in a fully voiced campaign built around your magical board game. Wishlist the full game now!

apps.name: Towers of Babble Demo
apps.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

apps.name: Traceroute Demo
apps.short_description: A network-building simulation across the cities of a nation. Lay routers and cables to design your network, balancing bandwidth and latency on a limited budget. Survive sudden traffic surges and DDoS attacks as you connect city after city, learning real networking concepts as you play.

apps.name: Trash to Trees:  Tidy up the forest! Demo
apps.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Tremen Demo
apps.short_description: Welcome to the TREMEN demo, an immersive and hyperviolent old-school shooter with modern graphics. Fight your way through two brutalist levels while you butcher every mutant that stands in your way with a wide variety of powerful, upgradable weapons.

apps.name: Trouble in Potion High Demo
apps.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever.

apps.name: Trucker Joe 2 Demo
apps.short_description: As Trucker Joe, you take control of your own freight company, buying trucks and a wide range of trailers to keep the companies’ supply chains running smoothly! Place the companies strategically on your map to avoid long hauls!

apps.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy! Demo
apps.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

apps.name: Twisted Childhood Demo
apps.short_description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? Start corrupting them. This demo opens five tales, five different games, and Wishes to bend their rules. Criquet is already waiting for you...

apps.name: UKNON Jones & Guynelk 2 Demo
apps.short_description: After Jones' friends are rescued, Jones discovers that his grandfather has mysteriously disappeared. He was looking for a mythical treasure called: "Crystal Cereal". Jones, Guynelk, Elsa and Princess Saphir decide to search for the crystal cereals to find Jones' grandfather.

apps.name: Umbra Survivors Demo
apps.short_description: Umbra Survivors is a dark 3D gothic survivors-like: fight through thousands of creatures, draft rare card upgrades, and forge devastating synergies before the next wave swallows you. Multiple heroes, brutal bosses, and every level-up can twist the run.

apps.name: Unburied Demo
apps.short_description: The free demo of Unburied, a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades by day, hold your keep by night, turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, and survive until dawn turns the dead to ash.

apps.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis Demo
apps.short_description: Experience the signature flight and superhero action of UNDEFEATED: Genesis. Fly freely across a section of Voltissia, wield a variety of superpowers, and face ferocious mutants. Your first step toward becoming the hero who will save this shattered world begins here.

apps.name: Undermoon Demo
apps.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Awaken in a strange moonlit town, build your hero, and climb a shifting tower. Read enemy intent, combine weapons, magic, summons, and elemental reactions, defeat deadly bosses, and uncover why everyone was brought to this world.

apps.name: Underway: Tales Of A Killer
apps.short_description:
