Some might say that "Underway" is basically a boss-rush fetch-quest. And while they might be right (if ALL of the story is ignored), what if there was a version that fit that inaccurate description a bit more?

Well... Now there is. But not in the way you think...

apps.name: Undying Flame Demo
apps.short_description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

apps.name: Unfanged: All fight, no bite Demo
apps.short_description: Unfanged is a 2D action-platformer where you help Dracula's  disappointing son fight back against the injustices he had to face. Jump, suck and stomp your way to the highscores! Stand against fierce boss battles, old acquaintances and new faces alike. Prove to all that dying is easy, living is hard!

apps.name: Unhappening Demo
apps.short_description: Navigate a collapsing world where light is your only protection. Solve physics-based environmental puzzles with the help of temporary companions, and survive the darkness consuming fractured memories of humanity’s final survivor. For fans of Inside, Limbo, and Little Nightmares.

apps.name: Unregistered Scene Demo
apps.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

apps.name: Unseen - Someone Demo
apps.short_description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

apps.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor Demo
apps.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

apps.name: URIEL OS Demo
apps.short_description: URIEL OS is an audio horror game where the perspective never leaves your screen. Traverse the apocalypse while sealed inside a mechanical vehicle that barely protects you from whatever is outside. Hack devices to manipulate the environment and piece together what happened to a very different Earth.

apps.name: Venison County Demo
apps.short_description: Grab your sawed-off, cast some sigils, and face the never ending nightmare head on in Venison County. Blast your old neighbors into undead venison giblets, master weapon specific active reloads, and limitlessly combine slain cultists' sigils for their sinful buffs (if you can withstand God's wrath).

apps.name: VERISMO Demo
apps.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily. This is the 15 minute prologue demo, with a longer demo in the works.

apps.name: VIGNETTE Demo
apps.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

apps.name: Villa Anzuelo: El Biógrafo de Difuntos Demo
apps.short_description: Try the opening of this illustrated gothic mystery adventure. Explore, examine clues and accompany Francisco to Villa Anzuelo. This free demo ends as you enter the mansion; continue the investigation in the full game.

apps.name: VIRUS_31.EXE Demo
apps.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

apps.name: Vital Decisions Demo
apps.short_description:
Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players.
Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. 
Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

apps.name: Vug: From Caves to Stars Demo
Warbound Demo
apps.short_description: Build your ultimate battle deck and lead your armies in epic strategic warfare. Collect powerful cards, conquer rival kingdoms, and rise to become the greatest ruler in WARBOUND!

apps.name: Yes, My Queen Demo
apps.short_description: The chess roguelike. Play game-changing cards, bend the rules, save your Queen, and escape from the dungeon.

apps.name: Yokai Mart Demo
apps.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Take over your grandmother’s konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

apps.name: Zombie Crawlers Demo
apps.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

apps.name: Zombie Motel 96 Demo
apps.short_description: Run a motel and design your own maze in this roguelike defense tycoon. Take in survivors and position them in your maze to repel zombie attacks. Combine rewards and relics as you fight to survive 96 days. If your defenses fall, start over with a new layout and build.

apps.name: Zombobox: Bredo Story Demo
apps.short_description: It seems like a zombie apocalypse has begun in the world, but it's somehow quiet... Maybe ask an elderly drunked person what happened? He says that he stopped everything, but how?

apps.name: 【パパたび】パパさ、旅系インフルエンサーで食っていこうと思っているんだ。【体験版】
apps.short_description: An unemployed dad and his college-student daughter set out to make a living as travel influencers. Puzzle out destinations from clues, pin them on the world map, and grow your channel with videos: geo-guessing meets streamer sim. Aim for one million followers, with 200+ history and geography trivia.

apps.name: かくれ鬼: Hide-and-Seek Horror Demo
apps.short_description:
This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game.
Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight.
With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness, the children must play KAKUREONI and bring the Ritual of Reincarnation to an end.

apps.name: しろを塗る Castle Paint Demo
でびるコネクショん 体験版
apps.short_description: This is the trial version of 'Devil Connection'.Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Kemono-Summoning Adventure Game

apps.name: ギリJumpスターラッシュ Demo
apps.short_description:
Experience the thrill of clearing obstacles at the very last moment!
Giri-Jump Star Rush is a side-scrolling platform action game built around the concept of "Giri-Jump" (Coyote Jump).

apps.name: ネビュラスカイ クロッシング Demo
apps.short_description: Nebula Sky Crossing is a game that blends 2D side-scrolling shooting—where you pilot a spaceship as a space trader—with station-based trading. Aim to conquer a galaxy filled with dangers such as pirates by mastering piloting skills and upgrades.

apps.name: ファンタジーワールド ～魔王の想いと真実と～ Demo
apps.short_description:
Experience the free demo of Fantasy World: The Demon Lord's Truth.

Create your own adventurer, battle through the opening chapter, explore Stage 1, collect equipment, and experience the beginning of this retro-inspired 2D hack-and-slash RPG.
developers: ダイスクリエーション / DiceCreation
publishers: ダイスクリエーション / DiceCreation

apps.name: ホロすと！ Demo
apps.short_description:
”ホロすと！ - Holo-Strike! -” is a stage-destruction, turn-based online co-op PvP game featuring VTubers from hololive.
Choose your favorite character and aim for victory in intense 3v3 online network battles!

apps.name: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www 体験版
apps.short_description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

apps.name: 人妻とカウントダウンASMR性交VR Demo
全小将 Demo
apps.short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

apps.name: 刀鍛冶 Demo
apps.short_description: This demo is a first day as a swordsmith's apprentice. Cut charcoal, light the hearth, work the bellows, heat the steel the master prepared, shape a tanto, and hang it on the rack. You cannot finish a Japanese sword here. Folding forge, quenching, and polishing will be implemented in Early Access.

apps.name: 列乌尼斯的挽歌 Demo
apps.short_description: A Magic Tower-style Strategy RPG with alchemy and progression. Play as Tasia and explore lost ruins with your companions. No unwinnable dead ends — plan your days freely, build your loadout, gather resources, and uncover the truth behind the [Calamity].

apps.name: 古今東西ダービー Demo
喵咪争霸 Demo
apps.short_description: Claws of Power is a cute, real-time card battle game. With a variety of unique and adorable cat cards, each one could be your key to victory. Strategize by building different decks and using items to overcome challenges and claim the throne as the ultimate cat leader.

apps.name: 大千世界2 Demo
apps.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

apps.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙 Demo
apps.short_description: A card-based roguelike game. Everyone knows how it started, but can you handle this one? Each card needs to be played in a logical sequence to continue the previous one, but now there are 120 cards, each with its own unique rules. One wrong judgment can end the entire game.

apps.name: 废土小饭馆 Demo
apps.short_description: Open a cozy little diner in a world recovering from the apocalypse! Grow and gather ingredients, cook homemade meals, and serve the townsfolk. Enjoy a heartwarming blend of farming, cooking, and restaurant management in this free demo.

apps.name: 悪徳受付嬢エリナ 体験版
apps.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. To pay for your sick sister’s medicine, will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape Elina’s fate.

apps.name: 我的精靈小助理 Demo
apps.short_description: a personalized desktop application that allows you to upload your own VRM characters, letting them statically accompany you on your desktop.

apps.name: 星糖學園 Demo
apps.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

apps.name: 暗黑深井 Demo
apps.short_description: Dark Well is a platformer deck-building roguelike. Every weapon brings its own skill cards — adjust your loadout to shape your deck. Craft gems with wild affixes to empower your cards. Use cards to move, take the angle, dodge the killing blow. Keep going down and explore the sunless depths!

apps.name: 未知守则 Demo
apps.short_description: Unknown Rules is an independently created multiplayer online horror game that supports 1-4 players.

apps.name: 止战之战：The Great War Demo
汉墓飞僵 Demo
apps.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

apps.name: 江湖大镖客 Demo
apps.short_description: Survive, explore, build and compete in martial arts Jianghu. Manage your physical and mental state. Construct your sect and defend against nightly raiders. Learn Five Elements internal arts and varied combat skills. Recruit workers and disciples to defeat rivals and expand your power.

apps.name: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory Demo
灵魂甜品Soulcake Demo
apps.short_description: Soul Cake explores diverse romantic themes including LGBTQ+ narratives and female-dominant dynamics, with prominent femdom storytelling woven throughout its branching routes. Is a multi-route romantic exploration AVG title built around visual novel storytelling and exploratory item collection.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

apps.name: 犯人当てラジオ Demo
apps.short_description:
This is a mystery novel game in which you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit.
The trial version allows you to play the full tutorial scenario, "Heise and the Locked-Room Mystery of Grit."
Read short detective stories,
and use cards and charts to deduce the solution.

apps.name: 王之萌国 Demo
apps.short_description:
You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom.
There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

apps.name: 白羊传：无庇护所 Demo
apps.short_description: 《TheWhiteLamb：NoShelter》 is a first-person horror shooter. In the abyssal depths of consciousness beneath a deep coma, every memory you refuse to face grows into a devouring labyrinth. What you seek to reclaim is not just your memories, but the very self on the verge of shattering.

apps.name: 真男人修仙 Demo
apps.short_description: A college student suddenly found himself transported to a world of cultivation, but due to an oversubscription of “human slots,” he was transformed into a katydid. He was then taken in as a spirit pet by an elder of the Celestial Divinity Sect. Because he was male, he was named “Guo Nan.”

apps.name: 若诅咒以爱之名 Demo
apps.short_description: A Denpa Bishoujo Psychological Horror Curio: A Visual Novel ❦ Mild Horror, Mild Suspense, and a Hint of Whimsical Madness ❦ We Hope You Find Your Own "Happy Ending" Among Multiple Conclusions ❦ A Major Plot Twist, Perhaps? ❦ Glimpse a sliver of truth in the liminal space between life and death.

apps.name: 营火与远征 Demo
apps.short_description: Build your camp, grow production, and train soldiers in Campfire & Conquest Demo. Gradually recruit a Paladin, Priest, and Bard. Explore a five-stage mine with a party of up to three heroes across three difficulty levels, then lead your army against the orc settlement.

apps.name: 蛆之房~悬置之镜之歌~ Demo
apps.short_description: Aliens turned humans into "maggots" – toiling underground, eating rotten flesh. Xingzhi has a house. Her and her tenants' fates are in your hands. Save Ku Yi? Follow Qi Qian? Each choice leads somewhere else. The road up is stained with blood. The answer is yours.

apps.name: 规则怪谈 Demo
apps.short_description:
Tick tock... Night shift begins.
Welcome to the world of Rules Kaidan. As you complete your tasks, remember the rules of each world at all costs. Never violate the taboos - it's your only way to survive.

apps.name: 诸界竞技场 Demo
apps.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

apps.name: 迷你电网 Demo
apps.short_description: Build a power grid across Wuhan's two rivers. Place plants and substations, match voltages and manage limited supplies as demand and policies change. Try Normal mode, a standalone tutorial, circuit switching and backup transfer, with pause controls and local saves.

apps.name: 重返校园2：首富上学 Demo
apps.short_description: A UE5 open-world comedy game. Play as a super-rich kid who is accidentally transported from a modern city to a medieval world. Explore both eras, complete quests, interact with NPCs, drive around, start fights, and enjoy a free and absurd time-travel adventure.

apps.name: 삼국사기 클래식 (Three Kingdoms Classic: Korea) Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a kingdom in a strategy game set in Korea’s Three Kingdoms era. Manage officers, troops and diplomacy, then command real-time field battles and sieges—or leave command to your officers. The demo lasts up to 12 in-game months, ending earlier when two or fewer other factions remain.

apps.name: 세페리아: 매트릭스 Demo
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

apps.name: ACE COMBAT 8 - Customizable Cosmetic Set
apps.short_description: This set contains items usable in ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE such as aircraft skins, an online lobby avatar outfit, and an upgrade part for use in Online Mode.

apps.name: Age of Empires II: DE - The Viking Sagas
apps.short_description: Unleash the fury of the North and lead the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians into epic Viking battles.

apps.name: Age of History 3: Smaller Map
apps.short_description:
Experience the thrill of grand strategy in a more manageable scale with Smaller Map.

apps.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Thorek Ironbrow
apps.short_description: As a legendary Lord, Thorek Ironbrow leads Ironbrow’s Expedition in his quest to recover the relics and help restore the Dwarf Empire. Thorek can also combine resources at the Anvil of Doom to craft powerful artefacts for his forces.

apps.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Nagash – Lords of the End Times
apps.short_description: Arise and seize the lands of the living as the Supreme Lord of Necromancy, Nagash, in Total War: WARHAMMER III, unleashing his forces of the undead upon the world in his ascension to godhood.

apps.name: Tutor's Gentle Trap-DLC The Deadly Tenderness of Stepmother and Aunt
apps.short_description: Early in the morning, Daphne suddenly died of sudden cardiac death. After the funeral, Thomas discovered his father's incestuous relationship with Elena and Alys. Three years later, he witnessed his father's grand wedding to Elena.

apps.name: Ultimate Shortcut Kit - Battlefield™ 6 and REDSEC

apps.short_description: This exclusive portrait comes with Stellaris: Season 10, allowing your empire to take the form of the elusive Vipra, beings of shifting atmosphere and smoke. Available immediately upon purchasing Stellaris: Season 10, it features 5 different phenotypes and ethereal custom animations.

apps.name: Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: Netherlands
apps.short_description: In this new expansion for the spectacular real-time strategy game from Eugen Systems, the unique and diverse Dutch units are finally playable! Choose between 80 units and enter into a coalition with West Germany.

apps.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - A Treacherous Adventure
apps.short_description: A Treacherous Adventure is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2. It contains a two adventure maps.

apps.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Chaos Wastes
apps.short_description: Chaos Wastes is a free update to Warhammer: Vermintide 2. Explore the unpredictable and dramatic lands of Chaos Wastes in this all-new 1-4 player co-op rogue-lite experience, expanding the Vermintide story in a new game mode.

apps.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Karak Azgaraz
apps.short_description: Karak Azgaraz is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2. It contains three remastered adventure maps from the fan-favorite DLC of the first Vermintide game and one brand-new map.

apps.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Return to the Reik
apps.short_description: Markus Kruber sets forth on a quest to recover his father’s sword, plundered during the fall of Ubersreik… and naturally, the rest of the Ubersreik Five offer their aid.

apps.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Verminous Dreams
apps.short_description: Verminous Dreams is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2, containing a three-part adventure, starting with The Forsaken Temple & Devious Delvings.

apps.name: Wingspan: Bird Packs Season Pass
apps.short_description: Grow your collection over time and enjoy even more variety in your avian flock.

apps.name: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Three
apps.short_description: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven: Part Three continues your story as you leave your hilltop outside Nightfall, Colorado with your group of survivors and travel to a new haven, a rural junkyard.

apps.name: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Two
apps.short_description: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven: Part Two continues your story as you escape Nightfall with your new group of survivors in search of a safe haven. Continue your story from part one, or skip right to the new chapters with a new character!

apps.name: 《只有她知曉光輝的名字》- 第一章
apps.short_description: A Hong Kong-made fantasy visual novel with hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation with full Cantonese and English text. Zero, bearer of every sin, flees with an all-knowing goddess and has 30 days to find herself. Each chapter is a film genre, with timed reaction battles, stealth mazes and minigames.

apps.name: 我在地府打麻将：恼热狂欢
apps.short_description: Demonic Mahjong's new DLC Heatwave Carnival turns sweltering hell into a fiery beach party! Meet 6 new characters, collect nearly 40 Figurines, explore new scenes, and use Scoring to turn tile patterns into rewards before winning a hand.

apps.name: 13Z
apps.short_description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

apps.name: 2027 毕业生工作
apps.short_description:
Where should the Class of 2027 go?
(This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

apps.name: 2ndwaves
apps.short_description: Connect 4+ blocks of the same color to clear them and build chain reactions. The controls are optimized for hard drops. Launch a second wave as you chase your target score. VS mode is also fun.

apps.name: 3D Printing Store Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and manage your own 3D printing store. Print products, manage filament and inventory, create multicolor prints, assemble finished items, set prices, serve customers, recycle waste, and expand your workshop with better equipment.

apps.name: 60 Days Adrift
apps.short_description: Shipwrecked with a girl, fish, cook, gather supplies and brave the weather on a raft. Some catches mutate into monsters: fight them on deck. Decide how to share food and water and whom to help. Get to know her. Will rescue come? Will you reach shore together? What awaits on day 60?

apps.name: 66 Lives
apps.short_description: You have 66 lives. Survive the Horde, loot ,mine, farm, upgrade town, and raise an army. No tutorial. No story. Just play.

apps.name: 99天生存指南
apps.short_description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

apps.name: A Day with Wuki
apps.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

apps.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
apps.short_description:
Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days?
Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

apps.name: A girl was singing in the church choir…
apps.short_description: A visual novel about a young woman walking through a strange forest at night.

apps.name: A Tidy Konbini
apps.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return over 1000 scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. No Skills, no time limits. Just a relaxing tidy up experience.

apps.name: A Wilder Menu
apps.short_description: A Wilder Menu is a side-scrolling cooking and restaurant sim. Forage and hunt across islands, mix ingredients to unlock over 100 dishes, and serve dinner aboard your boat. Hire and train staff, hear their stories, and spruce up your place. Doors open tonight. The menu's up to you.

apps.name: A Wonderful Cat Life
apps.short_description: A tiny open-world game where you experience a carefree life through a protagonist who wanders into the world of stray cats.

apps.name: A.C.H.E.S.
apps.short_description: Click, shop and minigame your way to the top. Collect clicks in order to ቻቹቹጋ ፱ነ buy upgrades, unlock collectables and get even more ጋቹረጎርጎዐ፱ነ clicks. Test your skills in a variety of mini games. Discover the story between the cracks. Do you have what it takes to prepare for the Grand Ascension?

apps.name: AbsoluteNeko
apps.short_description: AbsoluteNeko is a co-op action game for up to four players set in a Japanese neighborhood. Play as stray cats, run along walls, cars and rooftops, slip past patrolling dogs, and regroup before time runs out. Meow to save caught friends, and take pictures of your cats in photo mode.

apps.name: Abyssal Maw
apps.short_description: Control a sootball to hunt for the insatiable Abyssal Maw. Slay monsters, haul corpses with sootball, earn Corrupted Bone Shards. Trade for upgrades. Survive chaos challenges like lightning storms. As feeding escalates, mutations worsen—balance risks to sustain your fragile survival loop.

apps.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
apps.short_description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

apps.name: Acre of Aces
apps.short_description: Click a patch, harvest a patch. Build patterns and chains and watch the numbers roll from hundreds to hundreds of millions. Power up your seed cards each night, pick relics that amplify your strategy, and grow one small field into an ever-faster harvest machine. A farming deckbuilder roguelite.

apps.name: Action & Automation
apps.short_description: Fight on the front line as a Commander in a side-scrolling action-RTS where every Nut is physical. Build self-running machines as Flux or Forge—or infiltrate and turn enemy systems against them as Shade.

apps.name: Ad Iterum
apps.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

apps.name: AdorableCat
apps.short_description:
A cozy and relaxing desktop companion game filled with adorable cats.
Welcome a variety of cats into your family, care for them, and enjoy everyday life together.

apps.name: Adrift: Survival
apps.short_description: Adrift is a survival adventure set in a flooded world, where storms, scarcity, and the open ocean shape every choice you make while building a life afloat.

apps.name: Advancing Fronts
apps.short_description: Advancing Fronts is a real-time grand strategy game featuring procedurally generated maps and control over massive armies. Maximize your war industry and produce hundreds of units to overcome opponents in a bid for global domination.

apps.name: Aegis Defense
apps.short_description: Aegis Defense is a cyber-themed tower-defense roguelike. Draw cards to place towers and upgrades, then guide a corrupting swarm through the maze you create. Defend your core alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode.

apps.name: Aegis Vanguard
apps.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

apps.name: Aftergarden
apps.short_description: Don’t just dodge—blast through the barrage. Build your firepower and push back enemy hordes in a progression-focused 2D shooter. Collect weapons and allies, rethink your formation, then sortie again. Upgrade in town and push farther next run. Quick reflexes help, but smart builds keep you advancing.

apps.name: Agama versus Bugs
apps.short_description: Meet the ever-hungry bearded dragon. However, in pursuit of her next meal, she must watch out for various traps and obstacles lurking in the terrarium. Who will win in this adventure? an ever-hungry lizard or crunchy bugs?

apps.name: Age of Amelorn
apps.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

apps.name: Airstrike Protocol
apps.short_description: Fast-paced 2D roguelite shooter. Pick from 4 classes, aim with precision, and survive endless waves of enemies. Take down colossal war machines and forge devastating builds as the last line of defense.

apps.name: AL-Mafia
apps.short_description: AL-Mafia is an online social deduction game where players lie, investigate, save, silence, and vote each other out. Move through the map at night, use voice and text chat to deceive or defend yourself, and survive across maps with unique elimination systems.

apps.name: alda
apps.short_description: Tragedy strikes Makris, a nation built on the arts industry. Follow Alda, a high school girl, as she confronts a world in flux and the subtleties of the human heart. A new kind of linear visual novel portraying art, religion, society, ideology, and humanity with uncompromising realism.

apps.name: Algorithmage
apps.short_description: A roguelike where you fight through algorithms. This game is meant to teach the basics of algorithms while still having challenging gameplay through deck building and item optimisation. Find new items and spells to use in your algorithms and fight monsters in your way to complete your quest!

apps.name: Alienshire
apps.short_description: Alienshire is a tactical RTS built around short, replayable scenarios. Command your units, manage limited resources, and outsmart the enemy.

apps.name: AmaTisMo
apps.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

apps.name: Amiko Legends
apps.short_description: A creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

apps.name: Anathema Requiem
apps.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

apps.name: Andrew Labreck's Eden Within
apps.short_description: Eden Within has fast paced, reaction based combat with a unique fighting style in a hedge maze that the player must navigate through. The embodiment of Greed has taken over the area, and he will not leave easily. Explore to find enhancements, learn to use your portals in unique ways and face Greed.

apps.name: Animal Bookshop: Tidy & Sell
apps.short_description: An animal themed book organizing game with customers, shop customization, and a whole lot of tidying!

apps.name: Animal Farm
apps.short_description: A colorful online farm game about growing up and protecting others. Hatch from an egg or be born as a kitten or puppy, grow with players around the world, and become a guardian who protects the little ones on the farm.

apps.name: Animal Legends
apps.short_description: In this Action RPG, catch up to 45 unique pets that fight at your side! Raid dungeons, defeat bosses, build your base and defend it from enemy attacks, and face off in online 3 player Capture the Flag PvP!

apps.name: Animals Hate You
apps.short_description: This game is a 1-4 player troll game. You have to control the character to escape with friends while every animal in sight tries to snipe you. Top-down chaos, cruel traps, and places that really do not want you to leave.

apps.name: Anime Mosaic Puzzle
apps.short_description: Relax and restore 230 anime-style illustrations in this casual puzzle game. Drag square pieces into place on boards from 3x3 to 8x8, connect matching neighbors, improve your best times, and unlock Steam achievements—without time limits or fail states.

apps.name: Annie's DineInn
apps.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

apps.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
apps.short_description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

apps.name: Ant Mill Inc
apps.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

apps.name: Antichrist
apps.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

apps.name: Ants TD
apps.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

apps.name: Apex Armada
apps.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

apps.name: Aphasia
apps.short_description:
Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back?
Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are.
As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

apps.name: Apparatus Inspector
apps.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

apps.name: AquaDucked!
apps.short_description: A physics puzzle game about firing a rubber duck out of a cannon and getting it home in one piece. Place hoses, trampolines and fans, aim, fire, see what happens. 270 levels across 10 worlds, golf, a climbing mode, a level editor, and a pond full of levels other people made.

apps.name: Aquarium Days
apps.short_description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

apps.name: Arcade Cafe Simulator
apps.short_description: Build and run your own arcade cafe. Buy and arrange machines, welcome customers, maintain your equipment, serve food and drinks in your restaurant, expand your business, and transform a small arcade into a lively entertainment destination.

apps.name: Arcany
apps.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

apps.name: Ardhan
apps.short_description: Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight happens on a real board: minions trade, taunts hold the line, weapons break, and the deck you walk out with is never the deck you walked in with. 12 factions, 421 cards, 6 acts, Ascension 1–15 and a Daily Game shared by everyone.

apps.name: Arena of Realms
apps.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

apps.name: Arid Frontiers
apps.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

apps.name: Arms & Arts
apps.short_description: A dice-rolling RPG auto-battler roguelike. Pick up a random weapon, chain your own unique skill combos, and fight your way through every enemy and adventure on the road — and above all, keep an eye on your past self.

apps.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 2,942 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

apps.name: Artificial Ambition
apps.short_description: Build an AI company from a 2017 startup into an industry leader. Hire specialists, train models, launch products, and expand your headquarters. Balance compute costs, customer demand, and investor control in a real-time management strategy game.

apps.name: Artificially Stupid
apps.short_description: Blend into a crowd of glitchy office AIs — or hunt the bugs hiding among them. A slapstick social-deduction party game for 2–16 players: copy the crowd, fake your quirks, sabotage the coffee machine, and survive the QA tester's bat.

apps.name: As Long As She Forgot
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

apps.name: As The Leaves Fall
apps.short_description: Point-and-click adventure game with a thrilling, Native American-inspired narrative. Use your wit to solve fun and challenging puzzles as you explore and interact with the townsfolk of Birchwood Hollow and the Native reservation. Secrets will be uncovered, and truths revealed, as the leaves fall.

apps.name: Ashen Knight
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

apps.name: Ashes Of The Fallen
apps.short_description:
Ashes of the Fallen is a 2D action hack and slash RPG. Play as Arthur, a fallen warrior fighting his way out of the deepest dungeon. 
Battle deadly enemies, grow stronger, and rise to challenge the God of Time. Claim her crown and make one wish.

apps.name: Ashley AI
apps.short_description: No te pide tu atención, se la queda. Una compañera de escritorio con IA para Windows que habla contigo, te recuerda y controla tu PC de verdad ❤️.

apps.name: Ashram Online
apps.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

apps.name: Astra Bestiary
apps.short_description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

apps.name: Atana
apps.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

apps.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
apps.short_description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

apps.name: ATOM RPG 2
apps.short_description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

apps.name: Atomic Delivery
apps.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

apps.name: AutoArena
apps.short_description: AutoArena is a lineup-building auto-chess game. As a fortune-teller, use foresight to acquire divination cards and build your lineup. Engage in multiple rounds of battles against the traces of other fortune-tellers in the Stream of Memories, ultimately guiding yourself toward the right destiny!

apps.name: Avlo the Imp Wizard
apps.short_description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

apps.name: AXE DESCENT
apps.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

apps.name: Babylonian Twins
apps.short_description: The lost puzzle-platformer of ancient Babylon — made in Baghdad in 1993, back as the Definitive Edition in 2026. Freeze one twin to stone while the other dashes, drills and battles through five worlds. Includes the original 1993 Amiga game, fully playable — only on Steam.

apps.name: Backpack Dungeon Delver
apps.short_description: A challenging dungeon crawler with backpack management and turn-based combat. Fuse components to build powerful combos. From rats to demon lords, how deep can you go? Still in graybox, but already great fun!

apps.name: Backpack Seeker`s
apps.short_description: Backpack Seeker’s — a tactical RPG where your backpack decides everything! Collect, combine, and use items in unique ways to win. A living world, a nonlinear story, and hundreds of hidden mechanics await! Ready for an adventure where every item is a step to victory? 🎒⚔️

apps.name: Backrooms
apps.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

apps.name: Backrooms : The Threshold
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

apps.name: Backrooms Anomaly Project
apps.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore eerie corridors, study every detail, and spot anything that shouldn't be there. Move forward when everything is normal, or turn back when something is wrong. Avoid the darkness and run when something starts chasing you.

apps.name: BACKROOMS: PRIMAL
apps.short_description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

apps.name: Bad Pig House
apps.short_description: A CRAZY HORROR GAME INSPIRED BY “THE THREE LITTLE PIGS”! GATHER RESOURCES, BUILD BEFORE SUNSET, AND SURVIVE THE NIGHT WITH THE WOLF!

apps.name: BAKA TAO
apps.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

apps.name: Ball Bugz
apps.short_description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

apps.name: Banana Life Sim
apps.short_description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

apps.name: Bananageddon
apps.short_description: Bananageddon is a roguelite in which you will have to create and adapt your equipment to defeat the hordes of animals, who will try to prevent you from getting out with the bananas harvested for your tribute!

apps.name: Bandits are Coming
apps.short_description: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

apps.name: Baskets and Blooms
apps.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

apps.name: Bastion Rivals
apps.short_description: Build your stronghold and unleash automatic armies across two lanes. Master four fantasy factions, spells and counters. Ranked and unranked 1v1/2v2 multiplayer, leaderboards and community esports tournaments are planned for launch. Practice solo against AI.

apps.name: Battle Bot Tactics
apps.short_description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

apps.name: Battle Gaze
apps.short_description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

apps.name: BazaarBorn
apps.short_description: BazaarBorn is a second-hand trading simulation. Start with a small junk cart, buy and sell used items, bargain with customers, and grow your business step by step. Make smart deals and turn small profits into bigger opportunities.

apps.name: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom
apps.short_description: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiders become part of the environment while seekers blast suspicious blocks! But watch closely, hider blocks have slightly more beveled edges than ordinary blocks. Can you spot the difference?

apps.name: BEAR HORROR
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

apps.name: Beast Bastion
apps.short_description: A Roguelite auto-chess tower defense game. Recruit unique units, combine them with towers, and build synergies and builds. Defeat bosses to recruit them into your legion, and craft your ultimate roster through randomly generated runs.

apps.name: Beat Weaver
apps.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

apps.name: Beautiful Subordinates Kneeling Beside Hero
apps.short_description: The night shrouds a villa on the outskirts of New York. Jasper Gray returns, and beautiful subordinates such as Yasmin kneel to greet him. In daily life, they report intelligence and execute instructions, while a rift crisis is quietly approaching.

apps.name: BECOME LIFE
apps.short_description:
A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. 
Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

apps.name: BECROWNED
apps.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

apps.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
apps.short_description: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

apps.name: Before it Falls
apps.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

apps.name: Bento Story
apps.short_description: Bento Story is a bento-arranging simulator with a warm story about a girl deciding her future while serving customers and sending them off with a lunch box that says more than words.

apps.name: Beyond Grief
apps.short_description: An action roguelike set in ancient Egypt where you battle the gods, grow absurdly powerful through build-breaking synergies, kill, die and be reborn. Earning allies, making enemies, and befriending cats along the way.

apps.name: BeyondTheBorder
apps.short_description: You have wandered into the city of Aberrants, “Helikar.” To return to the human city of “Engine,” escape the city where Aberrants roam. A horror escape game.

apps.name: BIER RUSH!
apps.short_description: Carry towers of beer mugs through a packed Oktoberfest hall! Pour, stack, balance and serve: more mugs mean bigger scores and bigger spills. Chase a solo high score or play online with up to 4 players in competitive DUELL and chaotic TEAM SCHICHT co-op.

apps.name: Big Controller VR
apps.short_description: Play flat games using fun oversized controllers. Comes with 2 games included, but also works with all your desktop games that have controller support.

apps.name: Big Top
apps.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

apps.name: Bio-Shooter
apps.short_description: Medicine vs Germs, inside the human body. Play as glowing living-gel cells and microbes with guns grown from your own body in a fast, class-based online shooter. Battle across the Eye, the Lungs and the Follicles, where blinking eyelids, breathing lungs and sweat floods reshape every fight.

apps.name: Bit It
apps.short_description: A two player couch-coop platformer game: Jump, Fly and Enjoy your time with your beloved one!

apps.name: Blade Dodger
apps.short_description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

apps.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
apps.short_description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

apps.name: Blockfall
apps.short_description: BLOCKFALL is a first-person shooter in a blocky, fully destructible world made to enjoy with friends. Each round, gain an upgrade of your choice from a randomly selected array to boost your odds of victory. no two matches will be the same!

apps.name: Blood Soil
apps.short_description: By day you sow. By night they come for the harvest — so you make them the harvest. Kill monsters ON your crop beds, let the soil drink their blood, and watch it grow at dawn. A brutal farming defense with a shotgun, a scythe and a year of nightmares.

apps.name: BLOODY RAVE
apps.short_description: The rave is live. The vampires are real. Survive the night… if you can.

apps.name: Bloomcraft
apps.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

apps.name: Blotch
apps.short_description: Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
apps.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

apps.name: Board Dynasty
apps.short_description: Target rival buildings with disasters, race with action cards, or pass a bomb before it explodes. Board Dynasty combines property play, time travel and party modes on a 3D board. Play solo against computer rivals or with up to four local players.

apps.name: Board Kingdom
apps.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

apps.name: Bong N Brawl
apps.short_description: Dive into a chaotic bullet hell where every second of survival feels amazing! Packed with game-changing upgrades, wildly creative boss fights, and pure arcade fun. Dodge by a hair's breadth, unleash broken builds, and just let loose!

apps.name: Bonobros
apps.short_description: A free strategy game where both sides play at the same time. Plan three actions in secret, then watch everything resolve at once: moves, spells, duels. Take on other players in 1v1, or play solo with lessons and puzzles, including ones made by the community.

apps.name: Boris & the Second Sun
apps.short_description: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

apps.name: Bot Colony _redux
apps.short_description:
Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand!
In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy.
Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. 
Total conversational freedom.

apps.name: Bounty Monster Trucks
apps.short_description: Bounty Monster Truck is the game true fans have been waiting for. Design your own Monster Trucks, Make your own tracks in Arenas or Stadiums, including racing and freestyle modes, and many different truck bodies to choose from!

apps.name: Brain Cell
apps.short_description:
Brain Cell is a co-operative multiplayer adventure game. Play up to 4 players co-op to explore dungeons, complete puzzles, with twisting gravity physics.

Explore huge worlds with friends. Work together to complete mind bending puzzles and defeat bosses.

apps.name: Breadwinner - The Loaf Life Simulator
apps.short_description: Become the Breadwinner in this colourful 3D action-adventure! Explore strange worlds, collect crumbs and mysterious artifacts, solve objectives, avoid deadly traps and face bizarre enemies as you uncover the secrets of the Crumbverse.

apps.name: Bribe The Brave
apps.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm where heroes don't take orders - they take bribes. Build your settlement, place gold bounties on deadly monsters, and entice autonomous warriors, rogues, and mages to fight for your cause. Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

apps.name: Brighter than Burning
apps.short_description: A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers.

apps.name: Broken & Loved
apps.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of  Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

apps.name: Broken Build Simulator
apps.short_description: Love roguelites? Well so do I! So I made a game that combines them all, with modes like 20 Minutes Till Lunch and Vampire Revivers. Blast away at ridiculous monsters in this highly detailed and accurate simulation of what playing a video game is like.

apps.name: Brutal Magic
apps.short_description: Master devastating elemental magic in this fast-paced third-person fighting game. Chain explosive spells, outplay your opponent, and unleash spectacular magical combat in a visually stunning fantasy world. 1v1 duels where one hit ends the round.

apps.name: Bubble Hunters
apps.short_description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

apps.name: Buffet Simulator
apps.short_description:
Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. 

Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

apps.name: Bug Fix Billionaire
apps.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

apps.name: Bugs & Birdies
apps.short_description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

apps.name: Bullet Factory
apps.short_description: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

apps.name: BumpBall
apps.short_description: BumpBall is a turn-based multiplayer football game where you plan your moves, predict your opponents and launch your entire team at once. Master unique squads and abilities in fast, chaotic 4v4 matches.

apps.name: Bunny Hopper VR
apps.short_description: Bunny Hopper VR is a fast-paced VR platformer combining parkour, wall-running, precision jumps, and target shooting. Race through futuristic obstacle courses, master your movement, and hit targets on the go. Every second counts!

apps.name: Burger Shooter
apps.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

apps.name: BURN THE WITCH
apps.short_description:
THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH.  ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING.
I'M NOT AGAINST IT

apps.name: Campsite Architect
apps.short_description: Build and manage a seaside holiday park. From a simple campground with a bar to luxurious bungalows with a restaurant: you decide what your park looks like. You play as the owner and walk around the park yourself. Every guest and staff member has their own personality, needs and preferences.

apps.name: Can 'Em All
apps.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

apps.name: Candy Factory
apps.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

apps.name: Canvas Attack!
apps.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

apps.name: Capital Criminal
apps.short_description: Start in debt. Build an underworld empire in this retro economic strategy game. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and weigh police, gang and debt risks. Reinvest in longer campaigns and grow your fortune before the deadline: 30, 90 or 365 days.

apps.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
apps.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

apps.name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
apps.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

apps.name: Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life
apps.short_description: "Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life" is a card-stacking + urban survival simulation game.

apps.name: CardCraft Champions
apps.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

apps.name: Carnamole
apps.short_description: You are stuck in a hellish carnival where you are forced to play whack-a-mole to survive. Your captors seem to enjoy making you suffer. Will you survive in this hell hole?

apps.name: Carry the Pack Rack
apps.short_description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

apps.name: Carte Blanche
apps.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

apps.name: Cartomancy
apps.short_description:
Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be.

This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

apps.name: CARVEGRAM
apps.short_description: Carvegram is a satisfying puzzle game where you carve cute miniature figurines out of blocks. Inspired by 3D nonograms: use the numbers on each line to work out what to break and what to paint in this meditative brain-buster with over 300 puzzles that's easy to learn but hard to put down.

apps.name: CarveLight
apps.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based multiplayer artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Play solo, on the couch, or online.

apps.name: Castillon
apps.short_description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

apps.name: Castlefolk
apps.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

apps.name: Catalyst Core
apps.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

apps.name: Cats Love Cakes
apps.short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

apps.name: Caution Ahead: Part 3
apps.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

apps.name: Celestial Routes
apps.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

apps.name: Ceto-7
apps.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

apps.name: Chad Billionaire
apps.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

apps.name: Chaos Protocol
apps.short_description: Chaos Protocol is a horror TPS game currently being developed by a solo developer. Players must destroy enemies and corrupted Cores to cleanse the area.

apps.name: Charming Blood: Twelve days
apps.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

apps.name: Chess Fantasy
apps.short_description: Chess Fantasy is a 3D chess game where you customize the world around you. Play classic chess or evolve the rules into your own game modes, online or with friends. Battle rivals and complete challenges to unlock new pieces, and build a place that truly feels like home.

apps.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

apps.name: Chess Pit
apps.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

apps.name: Chinese Childhood
apps.short_description: School’s out. Play a round of marbles, stop for snacks, and head home when Mum calls. Be a boy or girl in a small Chinese town around 1998, with friends to meet, holidays to spend with family, and trips beyond the neighborhood.

apps.name: Chrono Commander
apps.short_description: Chrono Commander is a real-time strategy wargame (RTS) with time travel in 3.5 dimensions.

apps.name: Cinderpeak
apps.short_description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

apps.name: CityGenesis
apps.short_description: CityGenesis is an authentic city-building simulation where you nurture a living economy. As the ruler of a small city-state, develop your city’s industries and lead your citizens to prosperity.

apps.name: Clanker Buster
apps.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

apps.name: Claw and Conjure
apps.short_description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG flair. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

apps.name: Clayborn Idle
apps.short_description: Forge legendary gear, shape its stats, and chase the ideal build in Clayborn Idle – an incremental ARPG where semi-turn-based combat collides with a deep progression system. Build game-breaking combinations, grow your utility skills, and master a world shaped by both battle and craftsmanship.

apps.name: Cleanup Unit
apps.short_description: A first-person co-op horror-cleaning game where you explore procedurally generated museums, collect rubbish, scrub filthy floors and walls, manage your power, upgrade your cleaning gear, and survive the monsters stalking the exhibits.

apps.name: Click Flip
apps.short_description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

apps.name: Clone Clicker
apps.short_description: Build the clone empire of your dreams. Assign clones to do jobs, increasing your productivity and amassing even more riches with which you may create more clones. Reach for the stars and take the universe (and more) into your clutches.

apps.name: Cloud Infusion
apps.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

apps.name: CluckFront
apps.short_description: CluckFront is a top-down PvP looter-shooter featuring mutant chickens as the main characters. Choose your combat elevation: hold your ground on a specific tier or storm the heights. Select from a variety of Makeshift weapons, and various maps, and three game modes—either on online or via LAN

apps.name: Coastal Cargo
apps.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

apps.name: Cocaine Smuggler
apps.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

apps.name: COILBREAKER
apps.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

apps.name: Cold Response
apps.short_description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
apps.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

apps.name: Concrete Coffin
apps.short_description: The surface is gone. 11,581 survivors are crammed into an unfinished 10,000-capacity bunker. Balance 6 core resources, make critical choices on advisor reports, manage your workforce, and keep the shelter from collapsing.

apps.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
apps.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

apps.name: Condotta
apps.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

apps.name: Console Repair Simulator
apps.short_description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

apps.name: Containment Shift Company
apps.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

apps.name: CookTopia：料理乌托邦
apps.short_description: A cozy simulation game blending farming, animal care, and cooking. it invites you to a cheerful, colorful world where you shape your utopia through a simple yet dynamic economy. Enjoy quick, satisfying gameplay sessions as you grow crops, cook dishes, and build your dream community!

apps.name: Cosmic Clicker
apps.short_description: Build a cosmic energy empire in this colorful incremental sci-fi game. Click, automate production, unlock technologies, explore distant planets, collect artifacts, raise cosmic pets, and ascend to unlock permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Council & Conflict
apps.short_description: Assume the role of a national leader in an original world of competing powers, and steer your country through diplomacy, trade, internal politics, and war as crises test your ability to hold the state together and shape the world order. How will you lead?

apps.name: Coup de Grass
apps.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

apps.name: CourseCraze
apps.short_description: Hover at high speed through loops, halfpipes and wall rides. Chase gold medals, hunt your own ghost, build tracks, share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: Cover Up!
apps.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

apps.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe
apps.short_description: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?

apps.name: Cozy Crest
apps.short_description: Awaken ancient elemental powers, shape your home, and help villagers bring their island back to life. Settle into this cozy open-world life sim, solo or with up to three friends.

apps.name: Creature Lab 2
apps.short_description: Conquer the world in the name of science! Study DNA, create mutagens, and grow mutated limbs to design your own monsters. Send them on missions across the globe, spread panic, collect bodies, samples, and chemicals, then use them in your next experiments.

apps.name: Creepy Meal
apps.short_description:
Creepy Meal is a co-op exploration, survival, and cooking game where absolutely nothing is safe.
Players must explore mysterious locations, collect  ingredients, drag them back, and cook them into high-value dishes and try not to become part of the menu.

apps.name: CRIMVEIL
apps.short_description: CRIMVEIL is a 2D dark fantasy action-survival game. Fight monsters, unleash and upgrade skills, craft weapons, armor, and potions to protect the ancient ring from the black-armored invaders trying to destroy the barrier.

apps.name: Cropocalypse
apps.short_description: Plant. Grow. Harvest. Outplay. A farming party game for one to four farmers on one field. Spread your roots to wall off rivals, haul your harvest home, raid their stores and guard yours from foxes and bears. When the market bell rings, the farmer who sells the most wins.

apps.name: Crownslayers
apps.short_description: Crownslayers is a roguelite turn-based roleplaying game, where you get to control two teams of heroes across separate timelines. Battle your way through a series of universes, bending time and space to affect multiple timelines, and future playthroughs!

apps.name: Crumbeats
apps.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

apps.name: Crystal Ascend
apps.short_description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

apps.name: Cubalance
apps.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

apps.name: Cube Sweeper
apps.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

apps.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
apps.short_description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

apps.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
apps.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

apps.name: Curvelicious 2
