Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

apps.name: Island Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build your tropical island empire in Island Tycoon! Transport cargo, fly planes, explore oceans, build cities, and play with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: Isle Of Thundir
apps.short_description: Explore the world, Capture Towns and Villages,  Defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and level them up. Defend your Towns and villages.

apps.name: Islefolk
apps.short_description: A laidback island colony sim where autonomous villagers do the work. They'll chop wood, farm, mine, and build while also expanding your island tile by tile. No deaths, no fail states, just a colony that grows.

apps.name: ISTAKA
apps.short_description: ISTAKA is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder where you battle with Okey tiles. Form melds to deal damage, build powerful combos with special tiles, and cheat to turn the tables. Face masked opponents, upgrade your rack, and choose your path to the top as techno beats pulse around you.

apps.name: It Was Not a Suicide
apps.short_description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

apps.name: Jade Valley
apps.short_description:
Clear a quiet Chinese village, one rock at a time. 
Stack stones, carry them to the saw, and discover precious jade in this cozy first-person cleanup game. 
Buy handy upgrades, offer jade to ancient statues, and uncover the valley's secret at your own pace.

apps.name: JDM: Ph4ntom Driver
apps.short_description: Defeat the Demon King and save the Spirit World from Corruption in this action, racing, supernatural spin-off of JDM: Japanese Drift Master! Drive your JDM ride like a lethal weapon, drift through the corrupted open world, and smash hordes of Youkai as the Hero wielding the power of Destruction.

apps.name: JEEP HORROR
apps.short_description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

apps.name: Jenoria
apps.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

apps.name: Jewelmix
apps.short_description: The classics reimagined! Rearrange and stack falling multicolored columns to align three matching jewels. Test your speed and reflexes to beat the high score and unlock all 60 achievements!

apps.name: Junkyard Astronauts
apps.short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

apps.name: Jurassic Architect
apps.short_description: Build a cozy dinosaur zoo on the far side of a Portal. Visitors from our world buy tickets to meet real dinosaurs. Shape enclosures, research new species, hire keepers, rangers and vets, and keep fourteen kinds of dinosaurs happy before they start testing their fences.

apps.name: Just Another Guild Day
apps.short_description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

apps.name: Just bury!
apps.short_description:
The Trash Keeps Coming.
Run your own landfill!
Take in waste from all kinds of clients, three times a day!
Wash it, sort it, and recycle it!
Too much to handle? Burn it—or bury it.
Just bury it!
But land doesn't last forever.

apps.name: Kamira
apps.short_description: A multiplayer folk horror social deduction game for 4–12 players. Survive the nights in a cursed village where monsters hide among you. Lock your doors, finish tasks, gather clues, and vote at the chapel to burn the guilty on the pyre before the beast strikes again.

apps.name: Kanun 1919
apps.short_description: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!

apps.name: Karaoke Fails
apps.short_description: Sing your heart out and fail spectacularly! Karaoke Fails is an online party game for 2–6 friends: take the stage, belt out short songs, and survive a flood of emoji reactions, flying tomatoes and sneaky sabotage. Your friends rate you 1–5. Good luck!

apps.name: KEMONO SCHOOL DAYS
apps.short_description:
A peaceful school life as gentle as a spring breeze, and a relationship that hangs by a thread.
Where everyday life and thrills collide—
a visual novel about a romance between different species!

apps.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
apps.short_description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

apps.name: Keyboard Wizards
apps.short_description: Type to cast. Type faster to survive. Keyboard Wizards is a spell-typing duel: type a card's name to cast it, type your enemy's spell to counter it, and chain spells into combos. Build your deck from 60+ cut-paper cards and battle the monsters of Filipino folklore.

apps.name: KEYLINGS
apps.short_description: Every key on your keyboard becomes a tiny living creature. The more you type, the more your Keylings grow. They play, fall in love, and sometimes even fight in this charming life simulation. Compatible RGB devices can also react with synchronized lighting.

apps.name: KICKSHIFT
apps.short_description: An alternate Rocket League-like game if you are looking for a unique take on the genre, that's built with Rollback netcode.

apps.name: Kiminoseidayo
apps.short_description: Two to four friends control ONE character, but each of you owns only part of the controls and sees the course through a different camera. Walk, look, jump and dash together across floating toy courses, dodge hammers and a chaser, and when you fall, LAST INPUT shows exactly who pressed what.

apps.name: Kimodameshi Online
apps.short_description: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

apps.name: KING 4 A DAY
apps.short_description: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

apps.name: Kinhenge
apps.short_description: You don't play a hero, you play a bloodline. Kinhenge is an online survival game that starts in the Stone Age: survive hunger, cold and rain, raise heirs and share a living island with NPCs who have a trade, remember what they live through and build villages of their own.

apps.name: KnighTD
apps.short_description: Defend an ever-expanding procedural map where towers buff your units and every boss drops game-changing loot. Choose a class, master Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Physical units, and survive.

apps.name: Knightoria
apps.short_description: Take up your sword and become a brave knight! Fight monsters, leap across dangerous platforms, and battle your way through a colorful fantasy kingdom. Reach the end of each level and prove yourself as the kingdom's greatest knight!

apps.name: Knockout Master 2
apps.short_description: Knockout Master 2 is a choice-driven adult visual novel where you continue your journey as a boxer aiming for the world heavyweight title. The game is packed with sex, romance, drama, and a rich story.

apps.name: KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown-
apps.short_description:
An Item-Building 2D Bullet Hell Shooter Has Arrived!
The unique “ENEMY ATTACK SELECT” system can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
To overcome the disadvantages you face, you’ll need to make smart choices and build the best loadout possible from limited resources.

apps.name: Krigo's PlayPlace
apps.short_description: as a relative of the founder of a children’s playplace, you finally come back to the place many years after it was abandoned and much more..

apps.name: Kung Fu Addiction
apps.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

apps.name: Lagrange Front Idle
apps.short_description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while you are away. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

apps.name: LANDLORD
apps.short_description: Ordinary people, ordinary problems, and among them you - the landlord who rents apartments to them... And unfortunately, these ordinary people’s  problems automatically become your problems! Rent apartments, collect rent money, and be prepared! The life of a landlord won’t be easy!

apps.name: Lanternwood
apps.short_description: Go on an Auto Battler Adventure with a Party of Heroes, observe them struggle, strategically build their Inventories to synergize with each other and allow them to succeed past any danger. Explore a myriad of Skills, Creatures, Events and Areas in this Auto Battling Fantasy Adventure!

apps.name: Last Buzz
apps.short_description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

apps.name: Last Chance Hurling
apps.short_description: Hurling with the swing in your hands. Load the stick, drive through the ball, and take whatever strike the defender leaves you: a full swing with time, a jabbed snap under pressure. Fifteen a side, fast and readable. Then let the video review decide whether it was a point.

apps.name: Latin Simulator
apps.short_description: A school week full of Latin and a teacher with gallows humor, who is about to be replaced by AI. Survive five days of minigames, missions and bad decisions, expose the conspiracy, and find out what Friday's exam does to you. And to the school.

apps.name: Laura's secret diary
apps.short_description: Help Laura, a female merchant masquerading as a gentleman, pay off her debt and keep her desires in check in this quick-response stylel puzzle game!

apps.name: LaurEli & the Blood Dipped Manor
apps.short_description: An Ace Attorney/Danganronpa style Murder Mystery-esque Visual Novel where an unlikely duo must find the vampiric killer stalking the halls of a stormy manor.

apps.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
apps.short_description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

apps.name: Legacy Miner
apps.short_description: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

apps.name: Legend of Cina 2
apps.short_description: This game is made from the foundations of Legend of Cina, it's a turn-based strategy game and has 7 stages and 15 OSTs, each map will introduce a new character. The maximum level is 20 and characters can promote after level 10, they can also learn skills once they reach level 5 and 15.

apps.name: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a
apps.short_description: Alec Orbusier, a none-too-organized university archaeologist, sets off to recover a priceless artifact from a forgotten tomb. Nothing too difficult, really... A 2D puzzle-adventure full of rooms, devious traps, and secrets for the curious.

apps.name: Lethal Justice
apps.short_description: Restore order in this dystopian city of the future where your choices determine whether you gain the upper hand or succumb to the streets. Fight waves of criminals, mutants and cyborgs while upgrading your firepower. You are outnumbered, not outgunned.

apps.name: Lethal Love
apps.short_description:
Turn your love lethal.
Play as Kyoko, a yandere obsessed with her senpai.
Eliminate rivals, make deadly choices and unlock multiple endings with cute arts.
Now on PC with full controller support, enhanced graphics and constant updates. Currently in Early Access.

apps.name: Letters Past
apps.short_description: Play as a postman delivering a letter over a quiet mountain path. See the sights, journal your observations, discover secrets and piece together a story you can't experience all at once.

apps.name: Leviathan: Rhino
apps.short_description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

apps.name: Lewd Temple: Hentai Clicker
apps.short_description: A saucy 2D idle clicker where ancient Egypt meets seductive waifus. Tap to fight, defeat bosses to recruit bold new companions, and upgrade your girls to battle automatically. Chat with them in an in-game messenger and grow your collection.

apps.name: Libra Apocrypha
apps.short_description: A dark-fantasy deckbuilder with strategic turn-based combat and a haunting narrative of gods, fate, and rebellion.

apps.name: Light Odyssey
apps.short_description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

apps.name: Limbival
apps.short_description: One moment you're under a guillotine, the next you've lost every limb. The crowd wants a show. You want to survive. Rip the limbs off circus monsters, attach them to yourself, master them, and clear wave after wave to escape the circus.

apps.name: Liminophobia
apps.short_description: Walking and Swimming Simulator. No monsters. Explore liminal spaces where each level reflects different aspects of your mind. Savor the atmosphere and let your feelings guide you. Relax or feel anxious as you dive underwater. Overcome your fears in uncanny, unnerving, and eerie spaces.

apps.name: LineForgeBlackSmith
apps.short_description:
A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it.
In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

apps.name: Lines of Battle
apps.short_description: Command armies in tactical battles with simultaneous turns during the Napoleonic Wars. Lead forces through single-player strategy campaigns, master formations and flanking tactics, then test your skills in competitive 1v1 and 4v4 battles.

apps.name: Little Extinctions
apps.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

apps.name: Little Girls Escapeventures
apps.short_description:
The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations.
Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know?
Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

apps.name: LITTLE KNIGHT: HOMECOMING
apps.short_description: Return home as a little knight, rescue your neighbors and rebuild your raided village. A storybook 2D action game where combos, charged strikes, rolls and parries carry you through 16 boss fights.

apps.name: Little Spring
apps.short_description: Compress. Aim. Release. Guide a little spring through the pages of an old patent. Judge slopes, ride moving platforms and set curious mechanisms in motion across 20 handcrafted physics challenges. Unlock six springs, each with a character of its own.

apps.name: Littlest Catalyst
apps.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

apps.name: Live War
apps.short_description: Live War is a immersive 3D tactical strategy game that combines realistic visuals with intuitive gameplay. Strategically deploy soldiers, vehicles, with the most suitable commander, outmaneuver enemies with smart tactics. Every decision matters—will you claim victory through precision and strategy?

apps.name: Loam
apps.short_description: Loam is a cooperative game in an infinite world where players gather resources, craft equipment, build structures on the land or at sea, explore and fight dangerous creatures alone or with friends.

apps.name: Look At It
apps.short_description: A serious simulator about an important job: looking at a statue. Don’t look away. Compete on the global leaderboard to become the world’s greatest statue watcher.

apps.name: Loonyland 2: Winter Woods
apps.short_description: In this sequel to Halloween Hill, Loony pursues the Happy Stick Witch into the frigid Winter Woods where he must confront a whole new set of problems in Action-RPG gameplay. Craft items, mix potions, cast spells, murder teddy bears, you know the drill!

apps.name: Loot
apps.short_description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat!  Explore randomly generated dungeons in this ARPG Bullet Heaven.  Fight through endless waves of enemies to find what lies at the top.

apps.name: Loot Goblin Inc
apps.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

apps.name: Lords of the World
apps.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

apps.name: Lore: The Hunt
apps.short_description: Lore: The Hunt is an online asymmetric (4vs1) horror game where a relentless Hunter protecting their property tries to capture nimble Intruders as they try to break into catacombs under the Hunter's domain. Freerun or fight to escape or hunt down the Intruders using different powers and perks.

apps.name: Lost Gaijin
apps.short_description: Stranded in 1994 Japan with ¥250,000, a paper address, and almost no Japanese, you must interact, travel, and find your way through a persistent AI-directed world that teaches you the language as you play.

apps.name: Lost in the Desert with Giant Spiders
apps.short_description: The sand ripples, then splits open in a swarm of giant spiders. In this B-movie desert auto-shooter, read the ground, dodge the eruptions, and evolve your weapons as you push toward the next oasis. And they're only the beginning. Miles from help. Inches from fangs.

apps.name: Love, Death & My Daughter
apps.short_description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.

apps.name: Lover Completion Plan
apps.short_description: A 1st-person psychological horror & romance adventure. Amnesiac, you're trapped in a seemingly perfect, cozy room with a girl claiming to be "Haru". Find and "fix" anomalies through daily interaction. Each fix reveals more of the cruel truth. "Complete" this broken world to save her!

apps.name: Lucky's Scratch House
apps.short_description: Lucky’s Scratch House is a physics-based multiplayer bar hangout. Meet up with friends, shoot pool, play darts and other bar games, and see what happens when you start messing with the place and its regulars.

apps.name: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
apps.short_description:
You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone?
LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional visual novel where choices shape four characters' fates.
'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

apps.name: Lunar Mining
apps.short_description: Mine, melt, upgrade, repeat. Lunar Mining is a fast, casual incremental game built around tense 15-second mining runs. Smash lunar ore, smelt it into bars, and upgrade your drill between runs. Explore three biomes, battle bosses for rare artifacts, and chase Legendary ores across the Moon.

apps.name: Lust Tap
apps.short_description: Lust Tap — cinematic 3D adult clicker. Fill the bar, keep the rhythm, and unlock every scene. Easy to start. Hard to put down.

apps.name: Mad Ever After
apps.short_description:
Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike
FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs,
combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted
fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

apps.name: Made for Mages
apps.short_description: Run a magical workshop in a cozy crafting and automation sim. Explore a procedurally generated world, grow enchanted ingredients, decode sealed recipes, and build production lines. Fulfill orders for mages and grow your reputation with every delivery.

apps.name: Mafia Hotel
apps.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

apps.name: Mage of Corruption
apps.short_description:
Fight. Upgrade. Corrupt. Become overwhelmingly powerful.
Will you survive the assault... or become the ultimate force of evil?

apps.name: Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story
apps.short_description: Discover a world of adventure, fantasy, and magic in a vibrant hero quest, top-down retro-style pixel art action-adventure where fast-paced strategic positioning and well-timed attacks determine victory!

apps.name: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
apps.short_description:
Bullet Hell about Magical Girl!
Fight against Shadows and gain resources to upgrade the skill tree! Become stronger and defeat all the Witches! Save humanity in this short magical adventure!

apps.name: Make A Racket
apps.short_description: A plane crash has left El Pepra’s black market up for grabs. Build your criminal empire through production, burglary, and car theft. Automate your operation, bring rival gangs to heel, and become the biggest supplier in this satirical open-world crime sandbox.

apps.name: Make the 100-year-old underworld queen regain her youth and become my servant
apps.short_description: The low-class youth Benjamin awakens the nano power on the verge of death. After saving Ava, he makes a deal with the dying underworld old lady Sophia, making her regain her youth and become his servant, which attracts the attention of Nick Zimmerman.

apps.name: Maker Circuit
apps.short_description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

apps.name: Makers' Wake
apps.short_description: Make your own way in Makers' Wake, a fantasy MMORPG with 15 classes. Shape your character through skills, mastery, and unusual gear. Explore a world its makers left behind, face dungeon bosses with friends, craft and trade, and compete in PvP.

apps.name: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

apps.name: MaMills
apps.short_description: The 3D four-in-a-row game I played with my grandmother - now in a digital form. You can outsmart the Machine across five difficulties, solve 40 one-solution puzzles, or challenge a friend on the couch, over LAN or with Steam Remote Play Together.

apps.name: ManaPop!
apps.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

apps.name: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
apps.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

apps.name: Marble Machina
apps.short_description:
You wake up in a surreal factory with no memory of how you arrived. Punch cards operate strange machines, floors rise and fall beneath your feet, and teleporters lead who knows where.

You’re fairly sure you haven’t gone mad.

Still, just to be safe, you’d better collect all your marbles.

apps.name: March of Reveille
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy where every Order is a trade-off. Capture cities, command combined forces, and take up to three Orders into a match — each granting one unique strength and one real weakness. Missions, online play, CPU skirmishes, King of the Hill, Domination, and a map editor.

apps.name: Match 3 Kingdoms
apps.short_description: Match 3 Kingdoms is a match-3 roguelike game. Clear tiles to attack, cast skills, and gain resources. Special tiles and chains trigger combos. Runs have random maps, enemies, drops, and rewards. Combine active/passive stratagems, time moves, manage resources to win wars.

apps.name: Maxwell's Odyssey
apps.short_description: Explore the dungeons of an ancient castle in search of a vanished sorceress. Blast through monsters, solve puzzles, and dodge the deadly traps waiting inside.

apps.name: Mechs V Kaijus 2
apps.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

apps.name: Mediotorum
apps.short_description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

apps.name: Medusa's Gaze
apps.short_description: Every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? A new mind-bending first-person 3D puzzle-platformer adventure game involving light & shadow, life & death.

apps.name: Meeting the World:AIRA
apps.short_description: Feeling bored and need a chat? Fascinated by other cultures but can't communicate easily? Want an AI companion to help you out!

apps.name: Melodan
apps.short_description: Command mythical legions to victory in a fantasy auto-battler where every placement matters. Draft your troops, unlock magical upgrades, set your formations, and let the battle begin. Pure strategy, no clickfest. Prove your brilliance in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, or survive the escalating Co-op Horde.

apps.name: Memento Reverse
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy card game born from the classic memory game. Every card fires its effect the moment it is flipped, and what you remember becomes your hand. Battle the CPU, or connect Claude Desktop to play against Claude or watch Claude play its own matches.

apps.name: Mermaids are Seafood
apps.short_description: You're a new hire at a company that sells mermaids as seafood. Bet your blood, navigate conspiracies, and cook for customers in this psychological horror game with 11 endings. Are mermaids more like fish, people, or monsters?

apps.name: MetalMercs
apps.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Repair. Upgrade. PROFIT! A real-time tactical experience where you command your own mercenary outfit of mechs and mercs and adventure through randomly generated missions filled with rewards, glory, and bitter defeat.

apps.name: Microwave
apps.short_description: Microwave food in a dreamy, liminal space by yourself or with friends.

apps.name: Midwest90: Rapid City
apps.short_description: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a tycoon survival sim in a monster apocalypse. Run a roadhouse serving monster meat and choose between profit or the city's survival, because those who fight monsters risk becoming one. How far will you go to stay in business?

apps.name: Mine of despair
apps.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

apps.name: Mine Rogue
apps.short_description: Minesweeper logic meets roguelike builds. Dig every safe tile, place soil tiles and attach dozens of Marks, from Dynamite to Frogs and Planets, then watch a single click set off a chain across the board. Survive a Hazard every third floor on the way down to the 24th floor.

apps.name: MineMergeMatic
apps.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

apps.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
apps.short_description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

apps.name: Minesweeper Maker
apps.short_description: Minesweeper Maker is a grid based logic game where you can play and create countless puzzles with friends and the community.

apps.name: Mini Bash™
apps.short_description: The spiritual evolution of the iconic online social games of the 2000s. Mini Bash combines exploration, real-time party modes, and action with friends in a living, connected world. Customize your Mini and jump into PvP mini-games or team up in the co-op Dungeon Mode.

apps.name: Miskatonic University Art Club
apps.short_description: "A formless chaos, spilling blasphemous bubbles"... what is that supposed to look like?! Illustrate the Necronomicon with the Miskatonic University Art Club in this online draw-and-guess game for 2–12 players.

apps.name: Mithril
apps.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

apps.name: MMA Career Simulator
apps.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

apps.name: MMO Guild Manager
apps.short_description: MMO Guild Manager is a simulation game set in a fictional MMORPG, where your guild fights 5v5 match after match. Take a newly formed underdog guild to the top. Every loss has a reason. Figure it out, rebuild your team, and take down your rival.

apps.name: Mochi Cats
apps.short_description: Rotate and drop pairs of squishy cats, merge matching cats into bigger chonks, and keep grumpy cats apart in this cozy physics puzzle. Chase high scores and unlock new cat looks and rooms as you play.

apps.name: Modificator
apps.short_description:
A multiplayer extraction shooter built around self-modification. 



Hunt creatures, trade with rival factions, and equip Modificators salvaged from your kills to upgrade health, damage, fire-rate and more,  then extract before someone strips you for parts.

apps.name: MONO CHAMELEON
apps.short_description: Hide-and-seek, tag AND prop hunt on a retro handheld-style screen in four monochrome shades. PAINT yourself into the walls, disguise as a prop, or hunt with the catch-gun. 2–10 players, 5 modes, bots. Streaming? Up to 239 viewers watch from the audience seats and vote.

apps.name: Monster Cruncher
apps.short_description: Monster Cruncher​ is a short and satisfying active incremental game. Crush hordes of monsters, gather resources, and feed them into the Crusher. Unlock permanent upgrades through a massive skill tree and meta-progression!

apps.name: MONSTERLAY
apps.short_description: Enter the Monster Repository, where beings from countless worlds gather. Fight in quick attack and defense minigames, make shameless requests, and collect illustrated stories in this adult dark fantasy visual novel.

apps.name: More Than  A Woman - Season 1
apps.short_description: An emotionally charged kinetic visual novel about Hana, an aspiring actress whose relationships and career are slipping through her fingers - until a sudden transformation into a futanari throws her life into chaos and forces her to confront everything she thought she knew.

apps.name: Morse Depths: WWII
apps.short_description: Command a WWII submarine and use Morse code to launch torpedoes, intercept threats, and evade mines. Hunt targets through the periscope, expand your fleet, and face giant monsters lurking in the depths.

apps.name: Morse Operator
apps.short_description: The frontline depends on your radio. Tune in to Morse signals, crack enemy ciphers and track contacts on radar. Coordinate rescues and operations under pressure in a radio operator sim where a timely reply can save lives.

apps.name: MULTIMATUM
apps.short_description: MULTIMATUM is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelite elements about unfortunate multiworld adventurers, trapped in isolated worlds. Fight the protagonists’ tormenting past projections and return the blade of God to its owner in order to return home.

apps.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
apps.short_description: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

apps.name: Murciavania
apps.short_description: Explore a dark, folkloric Murcia in this 2D metroidvania. Master weapons, perfect parries and incantations, uncover hidden passages and cross into the mirrored Envés. 444 rooms, 47 bosses and two endings. Spanish and English text.

apps.name: Murino Adventures
apps.short_description: Survive the fog-filled ruins of Murino. Play as Drun and Ch, uncover Mellstroy’s experiments, and escape—or destroy—the creeping Fog before it consumes everything.

apps.name: murmures
apps.short_description: Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable. But something is hunting her, and every place seems to know what she still refuses to understand. Explore places filled with whispers, gather the fragments and roll your d20s to help Clara find a way out.

apps.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
apps.short_description: You are a yucky long-armed thief.  Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

apps.name: My Army Getting Stronger
apps.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

apps.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static
apps.short_description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Leave the office. And remember - The Spider is watching.

apps.name: My Paper Plane is Better
apps.short_description: Throw a paper plane into a city built for flight. Every run you finish becomes a track, and other players race your ghost on it. Skim rooftops, thread alleys, pop balloons and chase the longest glide.

apps.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

apps.name: My Tradwife is a Femboy?
apps.short_description: After your company nears collapse, a deal can save it if you marry the heiress of Anemaryn Capital. Lucy seems like the perfect 50s-style tradwife, until you discover she’s actually a femboy. Romance Lucy, Lexi, or both in this comedic, choice-driven visual novel.

apps.name: My Useless Hot MILF in the Party
apps.short_description: Forced into a dangerous expedition before the dungeon opens to the world, explore its depths in a classic first-person dungeon crawler. Train your MILF companion, solve puzzles, battle monsters, uncover secrets, and discover the truth hidden on the final floor.

apps.name: Mysteries of the House
apps.short_description: You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move.

apps.name: Mystic Seals
apps.short_description: Battle against terrible foes! Collect mystical powerups! Befriend adorably violent pets! Explore the mysterious Unjima Island and its demon-cursed shrines in a brand new twin-stick Rougelite Co-Op featuring Shrine Maiden Shizuka and her companions!

apps.name: N in One 中国骨牌合集：牌九、天九、接龙、顶牛
apps.short_description: Pull up a chair! Discover 16 domino games, from Pai Gow and traditional Tien Gow to connecting, collecting and matching tiles. Learn with illustrated practice, face two BOT difficulties, and unlock cozy table styles with play-earned points. A single-player collection with local saves.

apps.name: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
apps.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

apps.name: Nanokings
apps.short_description: Nanokings blends bullet heaven and Hack ’N’ Slash into a “Hack & Hell” roguelite experience. Fight waves of enemies, take down bosses, gather resources, and descend into dangerous instances where fast-paced combat takes over. Uncover the truth of a world where death is your teacher.

apps.name: NAQOO: BOLTFIRE
apps.short_description: Fast-paced local arena shooter for 2–4 players on one screen. Shoot, set traps, capture automated turrets, and blow up explosive barrels. Destructible arenas and customizable rules keep every match different, with quick rematches, petty tricks, instant karma, and plenty of laughs.

apps.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
apps.short_description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

apps.name: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
apps.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

apps.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
apps.short_description: The story takes place in an ancient Japan where the balance between humans and Yo-kai has begun to collapse. In this age of chaos, the Onmyo Bureau secretly creates its ultimate weapon — a karakuri Onmyoji apprentice known as “Navinosuke.”

apps.name: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
apps.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

apps.name: NecroSmash
apps.short_description: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new classes and new areas to test them in.

apps.name: Neighbor Duel
apps.short_description: Here, they’ll snatch items right out of your hands, knock your loot loose with a club to the back, and freeze you for five seconds so they can calmly make off with your grapes. Fight, use cunning, and haul ten items back to your base before your opponent does.

apps.name: Never Be Alone
apps.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

apps.name: Neverending Descent
apps.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon filled with deadly demons, powerful bosses, and valuable loot. Level up, upgrade your abilities, and collect stronger equipment as you fight your way deeper. Return safely with your treasures or risk everything to push further. How deep can you go?

apps.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
apps.short_description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

apps.name: Nidwess
apps.short_description:
An old-school arcade shoot 'em up set in a surreal, grotesque universe.
Aboard your ship, blast your way deep into an alien parasite's nest. Can you fight your way to the parasite queen and save the world? Switch weapons, Adapt to your surroundings, and discover what lurks in the depths of Nidwess.

apps.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
apps.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

apps.name: NIGHT MULE
apps.short_description: Two months behind on rent. An empty fridge. Then, a desperate choice. Step into the high-stakes underbelly of financial crime as a money mule. Withdraw illicit cash, outsmart aggressive robbers, and survive the dangerous streets shift after shift. How far will you go to secure your survival?

apps.name: Night Portable
apps.short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

apps.name: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
apps.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

apps.name: Nightshift; Nowhere
apps.short_description: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

apps.name: No Hikers Return
apps.short_description: No Hikers Return is a psychological thriller-drama, not a standard jump-scare horror game. It is a descent into a secluded home where your missing friend may already be part of a much darker collection.

apps.name: No more needles
apps.short_description:
Thousands of people searched haystacks on their farms for needles—and apparently, not carefully enough. 
Now the needles they missed have entered the supply chain. Inspect the bales and stop them before they reach the customers.
Every needle must be removed. Except one very special needle…

apps.name: No One Gets Through
apps.short_description: Free demo available! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

apps.name: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
apps.short_description: Your crown is on the line. Build your kingdom, place your bets, and cheat to keep it all. Put gold, harvests and entire settlements on the table against ruthless creditors in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder where your kingdom is the ultimate stake.

apps.name: Northgrave County
apps.short_description: Northgrave County is a third-person multiplayer zombie survival game. Scavenge a 20 x 20 km county, craft from over 450 items, fortify a safehouse, farm, drive and fight for every day on persistent dedicated servers, alone or with friends.

apps.name: NOT Home Free
apps.short_description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

apps.name: Number Bound
apps.short_description: Explore, battle, build, and collect in Number Bound, a family-friendly adventure where math and trivia unlock rewards. Play solo or with up to three friends, collect plushies, go fishing, build with nearly fully editable world objects. 3 Mini games including Fox Quest a game in a game!

apps.name: Obsidian Tower
apps.short_description: Defend the Obsidian Tower in a roguelike tower defense on procedurally generated hex paths. Build crossbows, flamethrowers, Tesla coils and mortars, combine fire, poison, ice and lightning, draft run cards between waves, and spend banked XP on permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
apps.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

apps.name: Occult Trap
apps.short_description:
Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures,
you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit.
Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

apps.name: OddXI
apps.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

apps.name: Odysseus' 13th Ship
apps.short_description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

apps.name: Oh No, Meteor!
apps.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

apps.name: OKeverything: Realm of Humanity
apps.short_description: Ethan, a community college history teacher, investigated the school's finances to fight for his daughter's custody. However, he was targeted by the Spade Society and the Veil Club, falling into a desperate situation of a humanity test, struggling to survive with his "sister" and "aunt".

apps.name: Old Man's Sushi
apps.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

apps.name: On Love, On Monsters
apps.short_description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

apps.name: One Hop Further
apps.short_description: Climb through five pixel-art worlds, switching lanes and dodging traps as the void rises beneath you. Unlock over 100 characters or draw your own, then chase a new high score with a keyboard, mouse, controller, or touch screen.

apps.name: OnzeFoot
apps.short_description: Manager de futebol clássico: assuma um clube num mundo de 8 países e 640 clubes, dispute liga, copa e um Mundial de clubes, negocie no mercado e responda a uma diretoria que cobra resultado. Gratuito para jogar, em Acesso Antecipado.

apps.name: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
apps.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

apps.name: Operation: Horumus
apps.short_description: Combine eight modules into 120 defense builds in a deadpan political-satire tower defense. Survive a seven-day story campaign, master a 100-stage maze, and stop every tanker crossing the Strait of Horumus.

apps.name: Orbifold
apps.short_description: Fight through mind-bending spherical arenas on your own or with friends. Scavenge for weapons, loot and creative upgrades in the twisted remnants of a broken planet. A warped world of inverted mayhem awaits.

apps.name: Oremus
apps.short_description: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

apps.name: Orestruck: Space Miner
apps.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi First Person Shooter inspired by the classics of the genre. Shoot and kick your way out of the war-torn planet to survive the attack of the space undead. Zombie blood has never splashed so good!

apps.name: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
apps.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

apps.name: Ourself
apps.short_description: Two players. One body. In this online co-op for 2, you steer one half of a ragdoll and your friend steers the other: one arm, one leg and one camera each. Walk in step, jump on the same beat, carry a box together and climb 400 m into the sky. One slips, you both fall. Voice chat built in.

apps.name: Outbreak Checkpoint
apps.short_description: Outbreak Checkpoint is a survival defense game where your inventory shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, merge upgrades, and fit attachments into a limited grid. Combine four elements to unleash powerful reactions and hold the line against growing enemy hordes.

apps.name: Outer Flame
apps.short_description: Outer Flame is a JRPG featuring a rich storyline, extensive exploration, and strategic turn‑based battles. The game presents an authentic, classic role‑playing experience.

apps.name: Outliers: Incrementum
apps.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

apps.name: Outsail The Sun
apps.short_description: Conquer dark oceans as the captain of a vampirate crew. Feast on sailor blood for roguelite-style upgrades, fend off mighty sea creatures with your overpowered builds, go treasure hunting, and outsail the sun to achieve bullet-heaven under the night sky!

apps.name: OverDoze
apps.short_description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

apps.name: Overinflated
apps.short_description: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.

apps.name: OVERPAINT
apps.short_description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

apps.name: Owl Skips
apps.short_description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

apps.name: PAC-SIDE
apps.short_description: PAC-SIDE is a fast-paced pacman-based horror game, where you can meet your old yellow friend! Wait.. It looks like something bad happened with him..

apps.name: Pachinko Realms: Tiki-Taka
apps.short_description: Master the pitch in this physics-based soccer pachinko game ! Launch your ball through traditional 3D Pachinko boards, chaining "Tiki-Taka" passes to reach the next stage ! Explore diverse stadium realms, collect tactical power-ups, and face goalkeepers in epic boss fights.

apps.name: Pact Warden
apps.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

apps.name: PactSworn
apps.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

apps.name: PAPER STRIKE
apps.short_description: Draw runes with your mouse in a 3v3 online party arena. Mix spells with instant physical abilities and fight short objective rounds. But drawing means standing still. Finish that rune or move? Choose your moment and push Armageddon toward the enemy camp.

apps.name: Party Link
apps.short_description: Party Link is a collection of Russian party games for groups. Launch on a big screen, connect friends from their phones via QR, and pick a show — memes, drawing, bluffing, and guessing games. Original modes with Russian voice-over — ready in a minute, no installs on phones.

apps.name: Pegs of Hell
apps.short_description: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

apps.name: Perfect Steel
apps.short_description: Perfect Steel is a turn based strategy RPG inspired by SNES and PSX era classics. It features grid based combat, class system, world map and a story to explore.

apps.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense
apps.short_description: Build your base turn by turn on a hex world map, then drop into real-time battles against thousands of alien creatures. Command marines, robots and tanks, fortify the gates with turrets, and survive 50 days of an evolving swarm in this low-poly defense roguelike.

apps.name: Phoning It In
apps.short_description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

apps.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
apps.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Brush dusty shards, match their shapes and colours, and bring light back to a mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and rebuild six windows at your own pace, with no deadlines or penalties.

apps.name: PIG IRON
apps.short_description:
PIGIRON is a fast-paced horde shooter with light mech-sim elements. 


Grind your way through hundreds of escaped Bio-engineered Meat Organisms with an arsenal of horrifying flesh-metal contraptions.

apps.name: Pigeonhole Principle
apps.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

apps.name: PIGFACE MASSACRE
apps.short_description: PIGFACE MASSACRE is a survival horror game can be played up-to 4 players. While trying to stay alive, uncover the serial killer PIGFACE's bloodcurdling mystery and find out the truth behind events.

apps.name: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
apps.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is an isometric 3D Zelda-like ARPG focused on dungeon exploration. Enter the shattered abyss: navigate multi-layered labyrinths, gather hidden relics to craft alchemical creations, and slay ancient tyrants in methodical, hard-hitting combat.

apps.name: Pillow Punk
apps.short_description: Pillow Punk is a fast-paced third-person action roguelite built around outrageous pillow combat. Fight escalating enemy waves with melee and ranged attacks, combine abilities with randomized upgrades, and challenge powerful bosses in a chaotic single-player adventure.

apps.name: Pimpin' Around
apps.short_description: Play as a pimp in the funky 1970s. Run the joint, slap the troublemakers and buy the place before the Pimp Boss buys you.

apps.name: PinUp Archery
apps.short_description: Stick rubber suction-cup arrows on pinup posters in this simple relaxing comedy archery game. Earn your cupid wings! Read the wind, land the hot spots, chain combos and unlock every Girl of the Month. Made with love by a solo developer.

apps.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about battling demons with a specialized deck of dominoes! Build your deck from nearly 75,000 possible unique configurations of dominoes, and augment your run with powerful charms and discover diabolical synergies.

apps.name: Pokremental
apps.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

apps.name: POLIS
apps.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

apps.name: Poolrooms Museum
apps.short_description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

apps.name: POOLİMİNAL
apps.short_description: POOLIMINAL is an atmospheric liminal space horror game set in endless, procedurally generated poolrooms. A Backrooms-inspired descent into thalassophobia, where the real terror lies in the dark water below.

apps.name: Portal: Lost in Aperture
apps.short_description: This is a mod for Portal 1. Includes new maps, storyline, a whole new Portal experience. After you play the game, every other mod will look simple, balanced and average. Lost in Aperture try to show, that the portal universe can be way bigger, and a lot more, then just solving puzzles.

apps.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.

apps.name: Potions Galore
apps.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess with no power-ups!

apps.name: PrankzPlz!
apps.short_description: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

apps.name: Princess 8/10
apps.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

apps.name: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager
apps.short_description: Pro Endurance Series Running manager: take your athlete from prospect to legend. Plan training, nutrition, gear and staff, pick your 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon races, and live every event in a real-time simulator where you set the pace and tactics.

apps.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
apps.short_description: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.

apps.name: Project 14
apps.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

apps.name: Project Athanor
apps.short_description: Build automated factories to produce and upgrade elemental cards, assemble a six-card deck, then enter survivor-style arenas, collect temporary power-ups, and push through escalating waves for as long as you can survive.

apps.name: Project NEUNLEBEN Alpha Defence Force
apps.short_description: An attack by an alien species, emerging from a dimensional rift, has begun! Shoot 'em up your way through 11 levels with the help of the "Alpha Defence Force", consisting of three cybernetically enhanced cats, and defeat screen-sized bosses in this retro 16-bit-inspired Shmup.

apps.name: Project Prison
apps.short_description:
Have you ever thought about the best place to start your criminal empire without any legal consequences?

Now you will finally be able to experience prison life in Project Prison. try to stay alive in a prison which contains’ s the world’s most ruthless inmates.

apps.name: Project Slimechan
apps.short_description: Experience tentacle scenes directly in 3D on PC or in 6DOF VR.

apps.name: Project TITAN
apps.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

apps.name: PROJECT_JUMP
apps.short_description: A precision first-person movement game. Air-strafe, bounce, and rocket-jump through hand-crafted jump maps with faithfully recreated 2000s-era physics, and chase records on leaderboards that track every route, category, and discipline.

apps.name: Prop Hazard
apps.short_description: In worlds where chairs, rocks, and trees hide lethal traps, master agile parkour—jumping and dashing through shifting death-mazes. Use pebbles to find hidden paths, glowsticks to see in the dark, and light to expose lies. The exit waits, but surviving to reach it won't be easy.

apps.name: Protocol Z
apps.short_description: A living zombie sandbox. Watch a whole town go about its day then unleash the outbreak. Play as anyone in first person, swim, fight and drive, spawn zombies, vehicles and buildings anywhere, and call down tsunamis and tornadoes while police and soldiers fight to hold the line in a city that can fall

apps.name: Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid
apps.short_description: Ilya, a worker in New York, merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua due to an explosion and gained superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee during the day and investigates the FX Group at night. He also has a complex entanglement with his proud boss, Natalie.

apps.name: Punch Rock
apps.short_description: A casual idle survival game in a small window beside your work. A lone climber wanders a mountain in real time. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or camp. Then get back to whatever you were doing. You cannot lose, and the mountain keeps its own time while you're away.

apps.name: Puzzle Scorpions
apps.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Puzzle Simulator
apps.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

apps.name: Quarterheart
apps.short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

apps.name: Queen's Pact
apps.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

apps.name: Quest Dice
apps.short_description: A book, a d20, a candle. Quest Dice is a solo pen-and-paper in three stories — write your own books and share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: QUIZ BREAKER
apps.short_description: Five contestants, one hidden Breaker who knows the answers. Race through four-choice buzzer quizzes, discuss suspicious answers, and use your Trigger to expose a suspect. Play with friends or join online alone with bot fill. Japanese-language gameplay.

apps.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
apps.short_description: Climb the sales ladder from the basement to the corner office. Cold-call, close deals, build a team, run a region — and hit your number every single month. A pixel-art idle career sim about the one figure that decides everything.

apps.name: RABIDZ
apps.short_description: An open-world co-op zombie survival game where the infected mutate every night you survive. Gather, craft, build and fight to see another sunrise.

apps.name: RAEV
apps.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

apps.name: Ragdoll Robotics
apps.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

apps.name: Raining Lead
apps.short_description: Twin-stick shooter meets action roguelike in a quest to burn corporate stocks. Mega Giga Corp takes your city. Their stock keeps climbing but you're the correction they didn't hedge against - A constructor of machines ready to burst their bubble. Destroy, loot, upgrade, repeat and lead the revolt.

apps.name: Raise
apps.short_description: Rise from the grave in a compact third-person soulslike. Battle undead and bosses, level up your character and master timed arena challenges. Every hit taken costs time; every parry improves your score. Refine your runs and compete on Steam leaderboards.

apps.name: Raise a Graz
apps.short_description: Raise and grow your very own Graz! Make him burp, spend your Burpo on increasingly peculiarly snacks, and feed him until he's ready to Asscend. A crude, colorful clicker with goblins, Burpo Frenzies, leeching Giovannis and 2-player online or LAN co-op.

apps.name: Rakuworld
apps.short_description: Draw your own hero and play as it. Your drawings come alive to face hordes of enemies across 11 worlds made of paper and crayon. 36 heroes, 22 bosses, evolving weapons and 1-4 player co-op.

apps.name: Ranch Attack: Farmer on the Run
apps.short_description: The goats are back and they have hired a bull. Grab, hurl, and outrun the herd in this updated version of Ranch Attack Classic: a fast, funny  arcade runner with two farmers, a barn full of unlockables, and the original prototype as a bonus.

apps.name: Rasterfall
apps.short_description: An open-world survival crafting game where every pixel is physically simulated and chemically reactive. Explore the world using a wide variety of materials, synthesize new substances, and build automated production lines. Multiplayer supported.

apps.name: Rayborne
apps.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

apps.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
apps.short_description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

apps.name: Re:collect
apps.short_description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

apps.name: REC:REWIND
apps.short_description:
Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him.
Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

apps.name: Red Father
apps.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

apps.name: Red Moon Cafe
apps.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

apps.name: Reef Break
apps.short_description: Reef Break is a realistic surfing simulation set in an untouched tropical paradise. Read the swell, paddle out through crystal water, and ride real-feeling waves across reef breaks teeming with life. No crowds, no scores, just you and the ocean.

apps.name: REELS of the DAMNED
apps.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

apps.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
apps.short_description: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.

apps.name: Reino Visigodo: Conquista de Hispania
apps.short_description: Forge your kingdom in Visigothic Hispania. Build cities, raise armies, and conquer territories in a real-time strategy game featuring 3D battles, sieges, and decisions that shape your destiny. Three game modes where ambition meets history.

apps.name: Rejected Draft
apps.short_description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

apps.name: Relocate Motorhome Simulator
apps.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

apps.name: RemparZ
apps.short_description: Medieval-fantasy tower defense: raise towers along the roads, upgrade them and hold through five Ages up to the dragons. Then send your army to storm forts held by the computer in the Conquest, defend a shared castle with a friend in Duo and grow your Bastion.

apps.name: Resident Evil 2 "R.P.D. Demo"
apps.short_description:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

apps.name: RETURN POLICY
apps.short_description: You work nights at a returns desk. Customers lie, haggle, guilt-trip you and throw punches, and you decide what gets accepted. Save up for a flat, feed the cat, don't go into the warehouse after three. The last guy on this shift went missing. Everyone in town tells it differently

apps.name: Reveria: Act 1
apps.short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

apps.name: Revery Effect
apps.short_description: Revery Effect is a 2D sandbox adventure! Explore an endlessly generated world, uncover ruins and histories, dig, build, fight, automate, and journey alone or with friends.

apps.name: Rex Summons a Meteor
apps.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

apps.name: Riddled Together
apps.short_description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

apps.name: Rideshare "Stimulator"
apps.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

apps.name: Rifted Worlds
apps.short_description: A fast-paced Action-RPG that takes place on the floating remnants of destroyed worlds. Discover fragments of your lost world, place them onto the map, and explore! It's time to uncover the truth behind your world's destruction...

apps.name: Rimfarers
apps.short_description: A classic turn-based space RPG. Trade between the worlds of five races, take on jobs, hunt pirates, rise in the fleet reserves and play dozens of text quests — while the Silence creeps in from the edge of the galaxy.

apps.name: RINGFALL
apps.short_description: The nations are cut into pieces by the meddling of the all-powerful tech syndicate known as The Ring. To survive in a world plagued by proxy wars and corporate espionage is to play along, and PLAY you will! RINGFALL is an upcoming PVP FPS focused on accessibility, fun, and classic FPS fundamentals.

apps.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
apps.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

apps.name: Rocket Punt
apps.short_description: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.

apps.name: Rogue Femme
apps.short_description: Rogue Femme is an adult roguelike deckbuilder set in a corrupt land. Craft a unique deck, discover powerful relics, fight dozens of monstergirls, and hold back the corruption as you try not to be transformed into one of them.

apps.name: Roof UP!
apps.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

apps.name: Rooklite
apps.short_description: A minimalist game about building your board and fighting for checkmate.

apps.name: Rotaliate
apps.short_description: A very simplistic fast paced puzzle game. Single player modes compete for most efficient or fastest time where multiplayer modes fight to be the first to clear their color from the board. Elo style ranking and more play modes coming eventually!

apps.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
apps.short_description:
An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp.
Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

apps.name: Ruler of Empires
apps.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

apps.name: RuneEra
apps.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

apps.name: Runehold
apps.short_description: Build up defenses, recruit helpers, gather items and defend the stronghold against an ever increasing number and difficulty of enemies who come at night.

apps.name: Rustown
