apps.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

apps.name: Ryze
apps.short_description: Ryze is an unforgiving, quirky, 2D platformer. Throw yourself to the top, past challenging and diverse biomes. But beware one misstep and the loss may turn out to be high... or low depending on perspective.

apps.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
apps.short_description: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

apps.name: Sancta Forma
apps.short_description: A puzzle game about one shape on a small board. Every move absorbs what you step on. Take your own kind and you grow stronger. Take the wrong kind and you start to come apart. 90+ rites, three hunters, and a Forge for building puzzles of your own.

apps.name: Sandkeeper
apps.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

apps.name: Satarichi: Heroes De Caelum
apps.short_description: Join the fight for Caelum in this cooperative action RPG for up to 4 players. Control legendary heroes in real-time combat as you explore an epic world based on Satarichi's original novel. Enjoy the adventure with friends locally or through Remote Play Together.

apps.name: Savory Seasons: Brizmere
apps.short_description: Escape to Brizmere, a simple and cozy haven for the beginning of a new life. Expand your farm, master the harvest and decorate through the changing seasons. Get to know the new world and neighbors, share the fresh harvests and discover the stories that make Brizmere so special.

apps.name: SCALING LAW
apps.short_description: Build an AI company in a psychological-horror incremental game. Label data, train models, expand across a global map, and automate your staff. Read the emails and conversations left behind as success turns unsettling. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

apps.name: Scawy Game
apps.short_description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

apps.name: SCP: Darkwater
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

apps.name: SCP: Project Pneuma
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

apps.name: Screen Stocks
apps.short_description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

apps.name: Screen Survivors
apps.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

apps.name: Sea Train
apps.short_description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

apps.name: Seagulls - Crappy Situation
apps.short_description: Defend a barely-floating raft in a chaotic solo or local co-op action rogue-lite. Shoot deranged seagulls, scrub the deck, dive for scrap, patch the damage, and buy questionable upgrades before the next wave ruins everything.

apps.name: Second Dawn
apps.short_description: Sent ahead alone to make a dead world breathe, you print machines, raise heat and air and turn Hearth green. But your warmth wakes a swarm beneath the ruins. Hold the line with turrets, then take the fight to its hives in tanks, walkers and gunships. Survival terraforming for 1–4 players.

apps.name: Seferia Matrix
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

apps.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
apps.short_description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

apps.name: Sellsword Tales
apps.short_description: A young warrior leaves home on a journey filled with battles and new encounters. Your choices affect not only the outcome of fights but also the relationships you build. Will they stay friends, or will something more develop? The path is yours to decide…

apps.name: Sentinel Trials
apps.short_description: Classic round based zombie survival game inspired by old school gameplay. Complete Trials, unlock weapons and perks, then hold your ground against the undead.

apps.name: Seri & Yuka with my heart
apps.short_description:
A healing visual novel about quiet everyday moments by the seaside, in cafés, gardens, and other peaceful places. 
Enjoy delicate watercolor art and soothing music as you observe the characters, surroundings, and passing time, uncovering hidden clues and stories within the silence.

apps.name: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
apps.short_description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

apps.name: Serpent City
apps.short_description: Serpent City is a turn-based board game of influence, trade and conflict. Accessible rules reward deep strategy: build your economy, outsmart your rivals and turn chance into opportunity. Play against computer opponents, locally with friends or online.

apps.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber
apps.short_description: The unemployed Louis Thompson accidentally catches a glimpse of the private moments of his neighbor, Holly Phillips, through the surveillance. The two then fall into a forbidden love, while mysterious nano-insects quietly set their sights on them.

apps.name: Shadow at Noon
apps.short_description: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

apps.name: Shadow of the Matrix
apps.short_description: Shadow of the Matrix is a fast-paced sci-fi third-person shooter set in a dark space environment. A mysterious enemy sabotages the systems of a colony ship. Fight back, restore control, and save the crew in this story-driven single-player action game.

apps.name: Shadow Realms RPG
apps.short_description: A free dark-fantasy idle ARPG in one persistent world: every player on the same ladder, with web and mobile cross-play on one account. Auto-battle for loot and affix builds, raid server-wide world bosses, climb the endless Eternal, war over clan castles. No energy walls. Power is never for sale.

apps.name: Shit Day : Dawn
apps.short_description:
SHIT DAY : DAWN is a first-person survival horror game set in Republic of Korea.
You will be required to survive the impossible at every moment.

This Shit day dawn.
You must survive.
But will you?
.. it might be impossible...

apps.name: Shopska Salad
apps.short_description: Defend your grandmother's salad from Bulgarian folk monsters in a first-person tower defense game. Set traps by day, then grab your shotgun to stop anything that gets through at night. Keep the salad fresh for seven nights, solo or with friends.

apps.name: SHOTRUN
apps.short_description: One shot. One kill. SHOTRUN throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

apps.name: Shred Inc.
apps.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

apps.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
apps.short_description: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

apps.name: Silk & Sorrow
apps.short_description: A hand-drawn, dark fantasy co-op adventure. Two orphans stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and bring back light to the Chrysalis.

apps.name: Silver Service
apps.short_description: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

apps.name: Silver Valley Screams
apps.short_description: Silver Valley may be full of dark corners, but your stomach won't fill itself. The year is 1975, and your father's disappearance is just the latest in a long string. Arm yourself if you plan to venture forth, find your father, and uncover the truth.

apps.name: Sime Returns
apps.short_description:
Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him.
Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

apps.name: Sir Loot-a-Lot
apps.short_description: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

apps.name: Siren's Well 2
apps.short_description: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."

apps.name: Sirens
apps.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

apps.name: Sketchy Warfare
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

apps.name: Skewered Up!
apps.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

apps.name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE)
apps.short_description: The Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE) is a tool used by many Skyrim mods that expands scripting capabilities and adds additional functionality to the game.

apps.name: SLAP
apps.short_description: A physics-driven co-op brawler for 1-4 players. Swing your weapon with your mouse, send monsters flying, survive waves and bosses, merge loot into stronger gear, and settle arguments with your friends in arena duels between waves.

apps.name: Slime Mine Survivor
apps.short_description: A roguelite action game blending 2D block mining with survivor-like combat. Dig deeper while dodging enemies and creeping poison gas, gather ores and treasure, then upgrade and evolve your pickaxe and weapons to build synergies and dominate enemies and the battlefield alike.

apps.name: Slime, Get out!
apps.short_description: Slime, Get out! is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle waves of monsters, collect weapons and upgrades, and create powerful builds. Choose your hero, survive increasingly dangerous enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

apps.name: SlimeTenPuzzle
apps.short_description: Create “10” for a quick, satisfying win in Slime Ten Puzzle, a relaxing brain-training game! Combine four number slimes using +, −, ×, and ÷ to make 10. Enjoy cute slimes while sharpening your mind, with adjustable rules for multiplication, division, negatives, and fractions.

apps.name: SLOTDOWN
apps.short_description: Grandpa left you an underground casino, a mountain of debt and a loan shark with a smile. Grow ten wild slot machines floor by floor, make allies or rivals, and outplay the Baron in a pop-art comic incremental. No real money. Ever.

apps.name: Slots & Skulls
apps.short_description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

apps.name: Slumber Craft
apps.short_description: Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair. Plan activities by day; build poker-style hands by night, from high card to full house, chain scores into Sleepiness. 21 nights, branching endings, and an Endless Mode asking how long you can keep weaving the dream.

apps.name: SLUP
apps.short_description: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

apps.name: Slurdle
apps.short_description: Slurdle is my first game, a collection of six word games for solo play and online multiplayer. Guess words, build them from tiles, search letter grids, spin through phrase puzzles, and add custom packs when you want something new.

apps.name: Smashboom
apps.short_description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

apps.name: Smawverse
apps.short_description: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?

apps.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
apps.short_description:
There is no tutorial.

And there won't be.

I believe in you. 

I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can.

You are snake who eats apples. 

j/k

You want to escape the grid loop.

BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

apps.name: SnatchDeck
apps.short_description:
Steal, Adapt, Survive!
SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

apps.name: Snotty's Sewer Reflushed
apps.short_description: Enter the sewer one more time! Snotty's Sewer Reflushed is the remastered indie horror where survival is key, and buttons must be pressed.

apps.name: Softfall
apps.short_description: A cozy winter MOBA on a snowy mountain. Two teams of five fight to chase the other team's eagle off the mountain. Quick matches, Easy to learn, and best with friends. The basics come down to: chopping down trees, fishing, and even hiding in the snow.

apps.name: Softwind
apps.short_description: Unwind with friends, take on trials, and compete in responsive real-time battles. Softwind is a cozy 2.5D top-down action game with playful community spaces, elemental equipment builds, solo and co-op trials, PvP, and arcade soccer.

apps.name: Sojourn Saga
apps.short_description: Sojourn Saga is a retro JRPG roguelite where every step through the dungeon is life or death. Build your party, raise evolving companions, master powerful gear and ornament combinations and descend 99 floors through a prison realm ruled by the woman who refused to stay dead

apps.name: Solar Arena
apps.short_description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

apps.name: Sole Ruler
apps.short_description: Kill across the whole star

apps.name: Soleil & Suspense
apps.short_description: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

apps.name: Some Things Stay Broken
apps.short_description: A short narrative adventure about repair, family, and a past left unanswered. Talk to customers, inspect objects, and make simple repairs as seven missed calls draw you back to an old phone. Around 30 minutes. Traditional Chinese only.

apps.name: Somewhere, Together
apps.short_description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

apps.name: SOS! Love~Controlled
apps.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

apps.name: SOUL BET PARTY
apps.short_description: A 2-4 player dice party game: Yacht scoring, plus character skills that flip the board. Fill thirteen categories with five dice while spending mana to multiply your turn, drain everyone else's total, or re-roll a category an opponent already locked in. The strongest skills cost you your own points.

apps.name: Soulful Slide
apps.short_description: A comfy and cozy sliding ice puzzle game with the twist of throwing snow along the path to solve puzzles. Featuring a combination of tranquil music and colorful art to bring in peaceful winter vibes. Collect gifts within levels to customize your own snowman as well.

apps.name: Souls Divided
apps.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

apps.name: Sound of the Night
apps.short_description: Own a nightclub and build it your way. Collect cash, design your space, manage your staff and reputation, and unlock new entertainment licenses to expand your business.

apps.name: Space Slinger
apps.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

apps.name: Space Squadron Command
apps.short_description: A tactical, dice-based space combat game inspired by tabletop wargames. Plot your maneuvers, activate your squadrons, and fight using an array of ship-to-ship weapons as you build a persistent roster of ships and pilots across a galaxy-spanning campaign.

apps.name: Spellvoc
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op game where 2–4 apprentice wizards use magic to fill orders, on the couch or online. Pull ingredients closer with telekinesis and fire up the cauldron with a fireball. Bridges collapse and trains barrel through, but your creations still have to reach the owl on time!

apps.name: SpellWeave
apps.short_description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

apps.name: Spin Tactics
apps.short_description: A roguelike engine-builder where you rig the slot machine. Everything on the board is yours to change, and a good run turns a lucky spin into an engine that doesn't need luck. No real-money gambling, no microtransactions.

apps.name: Spin To Win
apps.short_description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

apps.name: Spinova
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with slot-machine mechanics set in a world of Slavic mythology. Build and upgrade your symbols, summon Ancients, swear oaths and choose blessings to squeeze insane multipliers out of every spin and push further with each new run

apps.name: Spirits: Wake Up!
apps.short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

apps.name: Split Screen Shooter
apps.short_description:
It's 2009. You are at your bestfriends home, playing on the console of their big brother. A game you are too young to play, at a time where you should be doing your homework.
Thats this game, a generic shooter, but split screen!

apps.name: SplitOut
apps.short_description:
Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience

Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

apps.name: Spooky Land Defenders
apps.short_description: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

apps.name: Spooky Market
apps.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

apps.name: Stack Factory
apps.short_description: Drop pieces, complete lines, and build upward. Shape your blocks into factories, mine zerons to keep your economy running, and hire guardians to fight at your side.

apps.name: Stay in Your Lane
apps.short_description: A side-scrolling real-time strategy game inspired by Age of War and Swords & Soldiers. Mine gold, research your tech tree, summon idiom-powered units that march and fight on their own, and cast spells to turn the tide. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, and online 1v1 and 2v2.

apps.name: Stay Tuned
apps.short_description: Stay TUNEd is a simulation-based game, where you are an audio director, manipulating amateur band members' music to make them sound super super good! Hype up your audience; Boost band members' confidence by helping them out; Get introduced to the band; Enjoy the live concerts!

apps.name: Stellar Nursery
apps.short_description: Relight a dead sun and tend the worlds that circle it. Earth comes back to life, builds a city you name, and keeps a written record of all that follows. P.O.R.T.I.A., the caretaker who waited a hundred thousand years, keeps the watch with you. A quiet idle game that works while you are away.

apps.name: StickPuck GM
apps.short_description: Build your franchise, shape your league — and prove 200 hockey men wrong. Draft prospects, negotiate contracts and wheel and deal your way up to the trade deadline in a hockey management game that simulates the pros, all whole sticking to a scrappy underdog style that's all its own.

apps.name: Still Walking
apps.short_description: It doesn't run. It doesn't stop. Only one of you can see it. A first-person co-op horror game for 1–3 players: something walks toward you at your pace, wearing anyone's face. Four nights — a town, a motel, a school, a lake. Get out before dawn, or find a way to end it.

apps.name: Stock Baron
apps.short_description: Stock Baron is a strategy sim set in a fictional stock market. Become a market titan with vast capital, superior intel and an arsenal of trading tactics. Your moves sway prices, while other market players seize their chances. Enter a battle of wits amid fear and greed, and make your fortune!

apps.name: StoneEra
apps.short_description: Build a medieval voxel colony in an editable world. Guide villagers, research technologies, craft supplies, trade with a travelling merchant, raise animals, and engineer flowing water. Shape the terrain and create reusable building plans as your settlement grows.

apps.name: Stones
apps.short_description: Stones is a match-3 game about cutting gems. Swap to line up four for a blast, five for a prismatic that clears a whole colour, and chain cascades for the score. Thirty moves is all you get, but big play buys them back. One shared board a day, and eight finishes to earn.

apps.name: Stranding Echoes
apps.short_description: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

apps.name: Strange island
apps.short_description: You come to on a tropical island, unable to remember your name or how you got there. Explore the island and search for answers, but stay alert: someone is watching you, and the more you learn, the harder it becomes to trust your own conclusions.

apps.name: Street Boy
apps.short_description: One summer. One handcart. One big race. Help Arlinton hustle around a Jamaican seaside town to build a motorised cart for race day, look after Granny and his friends, and quietly expose the gangster hiding in his community. Play alone, or host and join friends online.

apps.name: Strike Wings
apps.short_description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen co-op, or in max 24-pilot online attrition battles.

apps.name: STRIKERS PRO LEAGUE
apps.short_description: STRIKERS PRO LEAGUE is a free-to-play 5v5 online football game where every pass, shot and tackle is down to you. No aim assist: charge your own power, shape the curl with spin and beat your marker. Create your player, join a club and climb the ranked ladder.

apps.name: Subject: Escape
apps.short_description: Escape a mysterious laboratory in a 2.5D puzzle platformer. Solve challenges, navigate experimental rooms, and find your way out.

apps.name: Succubus Crawler
apps.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where a True Ancestor succubus strolls ever deeper, burning everything in her way. She walks and casts on her own. You sidestep, pick upgrades, and pour your gold into a huge sigil tree to push one floor further.

apps.name: Suits of Fantasia
apps.short_description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

apps.name: SUMOO
apps.short_description: SUMOO is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

apps.name: Sunday Fighter Pilot
apps.short_description: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

apps.name: SunderBound
apps.short_description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

apps.name: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King
apps.short_description: A top-down action-adventure on an 8-bit cartridge, now seen in 3D. Cross a sunlit country, brave nine tombs, outwit their guardians and recover eight Sunstones. Walk it in the orbital 3/4 view, and take on a new tomb every day.

apps.name: Super Plants
apps.short_description: Super Plants is a short tower defense game about planting and growing super plants to defend against pests. Defeat enemies to unlock new plants and abilities, and grow the best defense.

apps.name: SuperButeo
apps.short_description: Table football inspired by Subbuteo. A turn-based strategy game: manage your energy and calibrate every millimetre. Compete online, climb the divisions and win tournaments. Build your club with its own crest, kits and stadium.

apps.name: Sushi Shogun
apps.short_description: Cook your army. Serve the village. Defend your kitchen. Sushi Shogun mixes real-time strategy with the bustle of a sushi kitchen: combine recipes and ingredients, fulfil orders, and lead a lively sushi army through Japanese-inspired maps.

apps.name: Swappy World
apps.short_description: Two main actions: swipe to move and tap to interact in an open-world survival crafting experience made through cards. Handle your energy tactically to survive as long as possible. Craft weapons, build your base and be prepared to explore a world full of secrets.

apps.name: Swing to Win
apps.short_description: Swing To Win is a chaotic free to play arena brawler where your weapon never stops spinning. Pick one of eight wild heroes, whirl through 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 battles, protect your leader and knock your rivals into lava, abysses and each other.

apps.name: SYNC - One Mecha, Two Pilots
apps.short_description: Meet dual-brain co-op: Two Pilots. One Mecha. Sync up (or screw up) to crush absurd Kaiju or rival duos in chaotic, over-the-top 2v2 battles.

apps.name: Synthwave Burnout VR
apps.short_description: Synthwave Burnout VR is an explosive arcade racing game in VR, inspired by the aesthetics of the ’80s and synthwave style. Strap on your headset, rev your engine, and blaze through neon-soaked tracks where every move, turn, and crash feels like you’re in the heart of a glowing retro-futuristic storm

apps.name: System Arrival
apps.short_description: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

apps.name: Tamagong
apps.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

apps.name: Tamer Tactics
apps.short_description: Draft, merge and evolve a team of monsters in a tactical PvP auto battler. Scout your Rivals, build Type Synergies and position your team on a hex board, then watch it battle recorded teams from other players. Every Journey is a fresh chance to climb the ranks.

apps.name: Task Bar Farm
apps.short_description: Build a 2-character team, defeat an army across 300 stages, and grow stronger with powerful items and upgrades in this 2D idle strategy RPG.

apps.name: Tavern Game Night
apps.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

apps.name: Tax Return
apps.short_description: If the suits at the SRI think they can fleece people's taxes, they'd better watch out for the wolf. Join Swindling Steve as you take back your hard-earned money from the SRI's collectors, but watch out for the high rollers behind the scenes.

apps.name: Tax-Force
apps.short_description: Hunt down tax-evading billionaires and rebuild society in a hand-drawn, action-roguelite platformer inspired by 90's comicbooks.

apps.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
apps.short_description: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

apps.name: Tearable Choices
apps.short_description: A card roguelite about ripping open booster packs. Crack boxes, rip packs, and score every pack by Attack × Power. Then face the real choice: sell your God-tier Legendary for cash, slot it into your Binder for permanent buffs, or send it off for grading and pray for a Gem Mint 10.

apps.name: Tears of Fire
apps.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of Tears of Fire! Explore the devastated Kingdom of Eden, face corrupted creatures, and uncover the secrets of a war-torn past in a hand-drawn 2D metroidvania adventure.

apps.name: Tech Legends Simulator
apps.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and grow it into a tech empire. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, ring up customers at a real cash register, build gaming PCs by hand, hire staff, run a LAN café, mine crypto and expand your HQ all the way to the second floor.

apps.name: Teddy TV
apps.short_description: You're the contestant on a deadly TV game show, and every enemy is a teddy bear. Blast through arenas of killer stuffed toys, grab the cash, build a ridiculous loadout and survive the show's star bosses. Then decide: cash out, or risk it all on one more round?

apps.name: Teeth Are Money
apps.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

apps.name: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

apps.name: Terminal Drift
apps.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

apps.name: Terraclysm Survivors
apps.short_description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 4 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

apps.name: Terrahold
apps.short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, reshape the terrain, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to your growth. Establish the link — or lose everything.

apps.name: Territorial Hissing
apps.short_description: Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Something smells fishy.  Save your home in this comedy adventure!

apps.name: The 31st Student
apps.short_description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, uncover conflicting records, and confront the memories you helped erase. A first-person psychological horror mystery with three endings. Play on a monitor or in VR.

apps.name: THE BACKWORLDS
apps.short_description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

apps.name: The Banishing Act
apps.short_description: The Banishing Act is a online co-op, horror investigation game. Demons are physically manifesting in the world and the number of haunted is on the rise. Play as a Banisher, find clues to identify Cursed Objects, and perform the Banishing Ritual, sending demons back to the abyss.

apps.name: The Big Suck
apps.short_description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and turn destruction into upgrades. Start with a blade of grass. Keep growing until you tear the planet apart.

apps.name: The Blind Warrior
apps.short_description: The Blind Warrior is a story-driven, third-person action-adventure set in 1860s colonial Java. Play as Barda, a Silat martial artist who fights against tyranny and ancient mysticism in a world inspired by Indonesian folklore.

apps.name: The Bots Want Your Gold!
apps.short_description: Defend your base from the robotic horde! Mine ores and sell them to make quick cash. Use your hard-earned money to buy weapons, attachments, and equipment that will assist you in defeating the bots! How long can you hold off the horde?

apps.name: The Burton Equation
apps.short_description: Time is an equation, and you're here to solve it. 1920s Chicago detective Zachary Burton must defeat the Combine's attempts to influence humanity's past in the 20s, 40s, and 80s, and then achieve victory in the present - all the while pursued by a dark mirror of himself.

apps.name: The Caretakers
apps.short_description: Infiltrate contaminated residences and deal with their mutant pests using the most advanced tech of the 1960s. Set up a base and observe, probe, and most importantly, survive the grotesque creatures in this online co-op horror game.

apps.name: The Factory Must Fall
apps.short_description:
Build the perfect factory, then let it go to war!
Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your enemies in this automation autobattler!

apps.name: The Forge: Steel Frontier
apps.short_description: The Forge is a mech-combat sci-fi action game. Step into the cockpit as mercenary pilot Ivan and fight alongside a mech with a soul—Machine Spirit. Dormant Dragon holds a strange and rare mineral. When wolves come for the ore, you and your mech must choose, and planet's fate hangs in the balance.

apps.name: The Hunger Below
apps.short_description: The Hunger Below is a brutal top-down dark fantasy action RPG for solo and online co-op. Forge your own path through an unforgiving medieval world where survival is never guaranteed, choices have consequences, and how you face the horrors ahead is entirely up to you.

apps.name: The Inconvenience Store
apps.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

apps.name: The Kept Fire
apps.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

apps.name: The Last Ace - Blackjack Roguelike
apps.short_description: Blackjack Roguelike. 3 lives, 60 levels, 12 bosses.

apps.name: The Light Of Vertical
apps.short_description: A Metroidvania-style action adventure set in the collapsing "Sky City." Play as a life form awakening in darkness, explore decaying areas, interact with NPCs, battle bosses, collect cards, and uncover the truth through stylized art and deep storytelling.

apps.name: The Mixer
apps.short_description: The Mixer is a unique take on a rhythm-driven rogue-lite where you create your own custom soundtrack by mixing-and-matching different music loops. Wield your own beat to conquer a dungeon full of rhythmic dangers.

apps.name: The One I Saw
apps.short_description: Return to a house based on the developer's real childhood home in this first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling loops, uncover buried memories, and experience supernatural events influenced by what you notice and what you miss.

apps.name: The Quantum Mechanic
apps.short_description: Employed by the Valen Federation in the war against invaders, repair alien technology and solve puzzles with your cat in a solar system on the brink of dimensional collapse. Featuring single-player campaign and online co-op, fight the invaders as a quantum mechanic, or with friends as robot cats.

apps.name: The Shattered
apps.short_description: The Shattered is a fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

apps.name: The Shrink Gun Game
apps.short_description: Shrink everything and everyone.  Fight your way to downtown, Upgrade and gain new abilities, Stomp the chief of the size police

apps.name: The Sinkhole
apps.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

apps.name: The Song Must Go On
apps.short_description: The Song Must Go On is a 1–4 player co-op rhythm platformer. Climb deadly towers, dodge brutal traps, and perform your part of a shared song. Keep the music alive, or the entire band pays the price.

apps.name: The Soul of Cosmos（灵魂乾坤）
apps.short_description: "The Soul of Cosmos"is a dark fantasy adventure game that combines plot choices, tower strategy, and simulation management gameplay. As an extraterrestrial soul, you will coexist with the young girl Yunxi, accompanying her on her journey to find her mother and explore different soul worlds.

apps.name: The Time After
apps.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game with a focus on driving and third person shooting. Travel through open world locations on foot and in car while scavenging fuel, scrap, food, guns and ammo to continue the journey south and escape the killing heat. Learn how we ended up here as you journey,

apps.name: The Usual, Please
apps.short_description: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.

apps.name: The Vigil
apps.short_description: Seven nights. One open coffin. No one coming to help. Keep the wake for your grandmother in this Romanian folk horror. Light a candle to see what the dead see, finish the old rites in her book, and don’t let her rise.

apps.name: The Water Game
apps.short_description: The classic water ring toss toy, now living on your desktop. Tap and charge water jets, land rings on pegs, and fill them for jackpots and chain reactions. Upgrade until it's raining rings, or let AUTO keep tossing while you work.

apps.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

apps.name: The Woodworking Game
apps.short_description: Run your own woodworking shop, complete customer orders, and craft furniture by hand. Saw and plane lumber, join parts with a freeform nailing system, mix paint, and customize your entire workshop just the way you want.

apps.name: Theatre of War: Rearmed
apps.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

apps.name: Theorem 4096
apps.short_description: Theorem 4096 is a number-merging puzzle game infused with mathematical theorems. Swipe and merge your way from natural numbers to fractions, roots, and infinity — every step connects you to the wisdom of great mathematicians

apps.name: Thicc Magic. Elves' Perverted Beauty Standards.gif
apps.short_description: A shoot 'em up where you can rip clothes off. More mana = thicсer thighs! Shilla is a VERY powerful elven sorceress, but the irony is that in elven society, fat is considered ugly!

apps.name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
apps.short_description: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

apps.name: Thieves and Gold
apps.short_description: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.

apps.name: Thieves Guild Master
apps.short_description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

apps.name: This is not Chess, It's War!
apps.short_description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

apps.name: Those Far Stars
apps.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

apps.name: THREADMILL
apps.short_description: Write code that controls an entire robotic workforce. Start with one worker, then scale to 128. Share jobs, feed machines, and adapt when power fails. Test your code in new facilities, then tune it to do more with less.

apps.name: Threat Axis
apps.short_description: An accessible multi-domain strategic military simulator. Command joint naval, air, ground, and subsurface forces in realistic modern combat operations. Threat Axis is the ultimate military command simulation platform for multi-domain modern warfare enthusiasts.

apps.name: Throw a Barrel Down a Hill
apps.short_description: Throw a barrel down a hill. Buy upgrades. Throw it again. That's the whole game.

apps.name: Tideturn
apps.short_description: TideTurn is a dynamic third person shooter where diverse characters and water-based weapons clash in a fight over the world's oceans! Submerge into water your weapons create to move seamlessly across any surface. Fight the enemy with movement and abilities limited only by your creativity!

apps.name: Tidy Farm
apps.short_description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

apps.name: Tidy up me eggs!
apps.short_description: 3,888 eggs. One cozy coop. A whole lot of sorting. Tidy up and organize a ridiculous variety of cute, silly, and wonderfully weird eggs. Just be careful what you break… the rooster has something to say about it!

apps.name: Time Jump
apps.short_description: You are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice, Time Jumper!

apps.name: Time Travelers: Late Ming
apps.short_description: Lead a group of modern-day time travelers in Hainan, China, in 1629. Build industry, develop technology, shape government, and command armies and fleets. Trade between two eras, forge alliances or wage war, and reshape the fate of the late Ming dynasty.

apps.name: Tiny Bomber
apps.short_description: Survive the countdown in a fast-paced vertical bullet-hell roguelite. Collect coins to extend your run, graze bullets for aircraft-specific boosts, build wild upgrade combos, turn defeated bosses into companion drones, tweak map spawns, and team up in 2-player co-op to push toward the final boss!

apps.name: Tiny Worlds: 3D Nonograms
apps.short_description: Tiny Worlds 3D Nonograms is a relaxing puzzle game. Paint and remove blocks to uncover a little sculpture and step-by-step reveal beautiful dioramas. Take your time to explore varied environments and solve even the most challenging puzzles.

apps.name: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck
apps.short_description: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck is a grid-based puzzle game where you rescue toppled tortoises and send them home while keeping track of your fuel! Venture through the arid desert, drive through portals, and find your lost lunchboxes. Will you find out exactly who tipped all the tortoises over?

apps.name: TitleIt!
apps.short_description: Turn a photo into the funniest caption. Write, vote and compete in quick online rounds with friends on Steam, Android and the web. Play for free, join with a room code and collect your winning moments. Optional purchases available.

apps.name: Tobias' Inferno
apps.short_description: Tobias' Inferno is a third-person mascot survival-horror game, where you are the mascot! Caught up in a zombie situation, you must escape the place you call home, while working with friends familiar, and unfamiliar! Explore a mysterious facility, fight the undead and earn your ticket to freedom!

apps.name: Tokioriki
apps.short_description: Every person you choose leaves someone else behind. Spend your limited afternoons building relationships, exploring the town, and recording each day in Kanata’s diary—then face timed Shadow Choices as an old book begins to fracture his ordinary life.

apps.name: Too Hot To Hold
apps.short_description: Grab the Ember and RUN! An up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

apps.name: Too Many Orbs!
apps.short_description: You fell asleep in magic class. Your punishment? Sort 3,493 magical orbs. Explore a magical orbirary, find where each orb belongs.

apps.name: Toon & Tune
apps.short_description: A Survival-Crafting Game combining all of your favourite mechanics from different games and genres. Fill your Item Collections, Max out your Weapons and Skills, Complete all Quests, Defeat Bosses, Increase your Stats, or just Build your Island.

apps.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Collect spinning tops, mix parts and take on rivals and tournaments! Run your own top shop, team up with friends in online co-op, or bring your custom build into a 1v1 battle.

apps.name: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
apps.short_description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

apps.name: Touhou Smash
apps.short_description: A 2D platform fighter where the girls of Gensokyo go at it. There are no health bars: damage builds as a percentage, and whoever launches the others past the blast zone wins. Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya and more each fight with their own moves. Up to 4 players, local or online.

apps.name: Tower of Hyakki
apps.short_description: A Japanese folklore dark fantasy hack-and-slash roguelite. Climb the tower of a hundred demons, cut down the yokai, gather gear, and forge a build of your own. Die, and the tower reshapes itself to wait for you again.

apps.name: Towers of Babble
apps.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

apps.name: Town Crazy
apps.short_description: Get across town before time runs out in different levels, find shortcuts, and dodge traffic and obstacles. Fast runs, unpredictable collisions, and leaderboard competition.

apps.name: Townlet
apps.short_description: A tiny medieval village lives on top of your taskbar. Every file you delete falls from the sky, and its little villagers turn your digital trash into new ideas, buildings and festivals. Watch a lone campfire grow into a walled town while you work.

apps.name: Townworks
apps.short_description: Townworks is a friendly crafting town builder: design the machines, place your blueprints, and grow a riverside hamlet from crates to home computers. Draw a workshop by hand, belt by belt and arm by arm, then build it all over town.

apps.name: Toy Battles
apps.short_description: Build a squad of toys, stack buffs, and chain game-breaking combos in this roguelite auto battler. Unlock something new each run, endless synergies awaits — break the game!

apps.name: TRACE IT
apps.short_description: A cozy paper-style train-track logic puzzle. Use the row and column numbers to lay one railway from entrance to exit; every level has exactly one solution. 500 levels plus Endless, Relax and Daily modes. Finish the line and watch the little train roll out.

apps.name: Train Survivor
apps.short_description: A survivors-like where you drive the train. Drive an armoured train through a valley overrun by the undead. Couple weapon wagons, pick upgrades and steer through switches while a horde of up to 1,500 skeletons closes in. Survive 15 minutes and face the Demon Lord.

apps.name: Trash to Trees:  Tidy up the forest!
apps.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

apps.name: Traveloot
apps.short_description: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight hordes of enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

apps.name: TreeLine
apps.short_description: Grow strange trees that don't exist in the wild, chop them down swing by swing, fill the morning truck, and pay off what you owe — one day at a time. A first-person orchard sim about honest work and heavy debt.

apps.name: Trials Of Belphegor
apps.short_description: A pixel art puzzle game where you solve room based challenges using strategic block style movement, unlocking the path to escape through a series of intricate traps and brain teasing RPG Themed puzzles. Can you apply logic and escape or will you fall victim to the trials?

apps.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
apps.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

apps.name: Trouble Makers
apps.short_description: Trouble Makers is the first & only BATTLE SURVIOR where causing chaos is your path to victory. Survive as long as you can, but more importantly, create trouble for your opponents. Dive into 4-player free-for-all showdowns, unleash TROUBLE, and wreak havoc while trying to survive!

apps.name: Tsuki Journey
apps.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

apps.name: Tumble Kart
apps.short_description: A cartoon kart racer where wipeouts are the highlight. Drift for boosts, trade toy items with rivals, tumble through chain-reaction pile-ups and hunt secret routes across 16 tracks. Race online with bots filling empty seats, or split-screen with up to 4 players on one PC.

apps.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
apps.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

apps.name: TV Beast
apps.short_description: TV Beast is a first-person survival horror game from the perspective of a body camera. Confront the TV Beast using a special remote control. Collect materials, solve puzzles, utilize various environmental devices, and upgrade the remote control to overcome the dangers created by the Beast.

apps.name: TWENTY+
apps.short_description: Draw toward 20. Turn the tables with + cards. TWENTY+ is a head-to-head card game with a shared deck numbered 1 to 11. Draw, stand, or change the target itself. Read your opponent's hidden card and time your + cards to swing the match. Play online or against the CPU.

apps.name: Twisted Childhood
apps.short_description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? You're going to corrupt them. Every tale is a different game — and make a Wish to bend its rules. Win your rounds... and your favorite princesses will never recover...

apps.name: Two-Fifteen
apps.short_description: A first-person PSX horror game. Your baby is gone, and the things wearing your in-laws' faces are still in the house. Get the lights back on, hide when you hear footsteps on the stairs, and never trust a voice that sounds like someone you love.

apps.name: Ugaris
apps.short_description: A free isometric MMORPG built in 2002 on the Astonia 3 engine — still running, still unforgiving, still free. No microtransactions. No hand-holding. Just a brutal old-school MMO kept alive by a community that refused to let it die.

apps.name: UK Politics Simulator
apps.short_description: Over 20,000 simulated politicians, journalists and activists. Every one unique. Every one autonomous. Build your career from local councillor to Prime Minister in the most detailed UK political simulation ever created. No scripts. Pure systems-driven gameplay.

apps.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
apps.short_description: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.

apps.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
apps.short_description: Build a team of gotchimon, pick their moves and fighting order, then watch them battle on their own. Play the story campaign, take on other players' teams in the PvP Arena, and keep a run going in a small corner window while you work.

apps.name: Unclaimed
apps.short_description: It's 1991. You work alone on the night shift at a remote cargo facility. As you sort shipments and complete your tasks, unexplained noises from the hallways, strange images appearing on security cameras, and a growing sense of unease begin to turn your shift into a nightmare.

apps.name: Undead Development 2
apps.short_description: Action survival carpentry. Nail anything to anything: drag, nail and build with a physics based barricading system to hold off the horde. A combat focused zombie survival experience for 1-4 players in online co-op.

apps.name: Underdog’s Comeback: 0DTE Options Game
apps.short_description: Start with $100 and chase a million-dollar comeback across 100 runs. A roguelike card game of 0DTE options, with post-session downtime in Moonward, where traders share their stories.

apps.name: Unexpected Tasks
apps.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

apps.name: University Architect
apps.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

apps.name: UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47
apps.short_description: 47 lives lost. 48 bodies recovered. Identify the victims of a fictional plane crash in this text-based deduction mystery. Cross-reference body records, passenger lists, medical reports, and personal effects to give every person back their name.

apps.name: UNLOADED
apps.short_description: Sort the boxes! Dodge the boxes! THROW the boxes at your friends! 4-8 players, one warehouse shift, zero chance anyone keeps their job.

apps.name: Unlucky Swordsmith
apps.short_description: Hammer your swords, take on increasingly risky upgrades, and sell your successful creations for profit in this casual swordsmithing game. Failed upgrades shatter your sword, but even the broken scraps can be recycled to improve your forge.

apps.name: V-BuddyUltraDeluxe
apps.short_description:
VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever!
Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

apps.name: Veilkeeper
apps.short_description: A tactical RPG where your army shrinks the deeper you push. Lead fragile expeditions into unstable rifts, secure relay nodes to hold your connection, and build a shard that grows stronger with every return. Decide when to advance, when to retreat, and what you're willing to leave behind.

apps.name: Veltarum
apps.short_description: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

apps.name: Vena
apps.short_description: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.

apps.name: Vermin God
apps.short_description: A grotesque body horror visual novel inspired by SCP-027, play as the young host of the Vermin God. Wake up in a hidden lab with no memories and experience the terror of a mysterious disease turning your body into a living hive for swarms of pests. Make choices to escape the crawling chaos.

apps.name: VibeMarket
apps.short_description: Run a lone trading card shop in a post-apocalyptic world. Stock shelves, serve customers, rip packs and hunt rare pulls. Grow your scrappy little store, build a collection worth showing off, and keep the lights on for one more day.

apps.name: Villa Anzuelo: El Biógrafo de Difuntos
apps.short_description: A writing commission takes you to a mansion above the sea. Uncover its secrets, listen to its inhabitants and piece together a story in which the dead still have something to say.

apps.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
apps.short_description: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

apps.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE
apps.short_description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

apps.name: VOXFRAG
apps.short_description: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.

apps.name: Voxie Survivor
apps.short_description: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

apps.name: Wallet Street
apps.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

apps.name: Warcamp Rivals
apps.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

apps.name: Warcaste TCG
apps.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters.  Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield.  Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

apps.name: Ward Off Evil
apps.short_description: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

apps.name: Was Silence
apps.short_description: Was Silence is an atmospheric 2D exploration visual novel about Ian, a guitarist as sound slips away. He meets others who have each lost a single sense, walking a world of silence together — holding on to what still remains.

apps.name: Waste Of Life
apps.short_description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

apps.name: Water Margin: Defiance
apps.short_description: "Water Margin: Defiance" is an action RPG set in the 14th-century Chinese classic "Water Margin" ("Outlaws of the Marsh"). Choose your path between good and evil, fight in fast-paced combat, or strike unseen from the shadows. Step into a world where legend and reality intertwine.

apps.name: We Are Surrounded
apps.short_description: Four heroes stand back to back on a floating island as hundreds of monsters close in. Place their rally points, then watch them fight on their own. Spend the loot on five upgrade trees, come back stronger and defeat the enemies.

apps.name: Welcome To HillVeil
apps.short_description: An atmospheric 3D puzzle exploration game about cheering up the lovely folks of HillVeil and making memories that last a lifetime! . . . . . what is it hiding?

apps.name: Welcome to Sunnybrook
apps.short_description:
Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape.

Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unwary residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich".

apps.name: What Remains Inside
apps.short_description: What Remains Inside is a psychological thriller where your task is to clean a house. Interactable lights, notes, and more lead you to discover the secret within...

apps.name: What The Cluck
apps.short_description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

apps.name: When Pigs Fly
apps.short_description: Build the plane while you're flying it! When Pigs Fly is a physics co-op game for 1–4 players. Grapple scrap, bolt it onto your cart, and transform into a plane mid-flight. Dodge wolves, fall constantly, and reach the destination island before the whole thing comes apart.

apps.name: When The Sun Dies
apps.short_description: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival game set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where players explore deadly biomes, survive radiation storms, and upgrade their weapons to face what lies beyond the fog.

apps.name: Where I am Not
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

apps.name: Whispering Meadows
apps.short_description: Whispering Meadows is a cozy farming and life simulation game where you can farm, build, explore, and restore a world consumed by mysterious pollution. Play solo or with friends, grow your dream farm, and bring nature back to life in a charming, ever-changing world.

apps.name: Who Heckled?
apps.short_description: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

apps.name: WiccAtriX
apps.short_description:
Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use
in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

apps.name: William 2
apps.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

apps.name: Withstand The Horde
apps.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies - up to 2,500 zombies at once, simulated on your GPU. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

apps.name: Wizard Magic
apps.short_description:
An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime.

Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

apps.name: Wizard X World
apps.short_description:
Wizard X World offers a great experience as one of the best action games for kids.
This game contains of special 3D graphics system helps with imagination.
Prepare yourself and embrace the fantasy world.

apps.name: Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge (SFC Version)
apps.short_description: The 1995 Super Famicom version of Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge, ported as-is. Form a party of six, explore a first-person 3D dungeon step by step, and fight turn-based battles. Draw your portraits, train skills, and uncover the castle's secrets. Save anytime.

apps.name: WN_RPG 1B
apps.short_description:
It's a JRPG.
A heartwarming world.
Turn-based battle. A simple Mini-games.

apps.name: Work From Dungeon
apps.short_description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

apps.name: World of Stick
apps.short_description: Build your base. Raise your army. Crush your enemies!

apps.name: Worlds Smash Expedition
apps.short_description: Blast through 500 puzzle levels across ten illustrated worlds. Rescue astronauts, unleash ship powers and combine special pieces to overcome obstacles and planetary bosses in a colorful space puzzle adventure.

apps.name: Wove
apps.short_description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

apps.name: XEN
apps.short_description: XEN is a fantasy action game where speed is power.

apps.name: XENOFLEKT
apps.short_description:
XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into your weapons: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, trigger devastating counter-attacks. 
Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

apps.name: Xenogarden
apps.short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

apps.name: Yang
apps.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure following a mysterious invitation. Explore the road to the station, interact with your surroundings, and discover what awaits you at 11:00 PM.

apps.name: Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween
apps.short_description: Woke up in a filthy dungeon? Check. Accused of destroying a holiday? Check. In Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween, battle your way through a ridiculously powerful gang literally named "Halloween". Dismantle the spooky season boss by boss, destroy the candy and tricks, and slay the night!

apps.name: Yo soy páramo
apps.short_description: Lead a clan of survivors and manage humanity's last settlement as the world dies. How long can you hold out? Learn, manage scarce resources, make tough choices, recover powerful technology from the old world, and be the last one standing on Earth.

apps.name: Young Suns
apps.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

apps.name: Zangyou: Overtime
apps.short_description: The workday is over. The building disagrees. Trapped on the 32nd floor of a Tokyo office tower, you must escape a hostile AI that seals exits, shifts corridors, and hunts you through the building.

apps.name: Zaria
apps.short_description:
A young family finds itself at the heart of an unprecedented family drama.
Manipulate the all-powerful white and black dices in this turn-based narrative roguelike, and help them get out of this mess.

apps.name: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
apps.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

apps.name: Zombie Crawlers
apps.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

apps.name: Zombie Panic!
apps.short_description: Zombie Panic! was an old prototype survival-horror cooperative Half-Life 1 modification, first released back on Oct 31, 2004 as a beta via ModDB and now re-released officially on Steam for free!

apps.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
apps.short_description:
Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? 
Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer.
Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

apps.name: Zombie Warz
apps.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

apps.name: Zombies Hate to Die
apps.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

apps.name: Zotenhold
apps.short_description: Endless Survival. 24+ Classes. Hordes of enemies, unique skill trees. Thousands of items. 10 Player CO-OP. Can you Survive against the horde?

apps.name: Дорога Жизни
apps.short_description: In the winter of 1942, you drive a GAZ-AA truck across frozen Lake Ladoga, carrying supplies to besieged Leningrad. Blizzards hide the road, your engine can fail far from shore, and enemy aircraft patrol the sky. You’ll meet people who need your help, and it’s up to you whether to stop.

apps.name: しろを塗る Castle Paint
apps.short_description: Paint the floors your color and capture castles in this casual 3D arena battler. Explore an open plaza with island minigames and paint puzzles, or build your own stages with the level editor. Play solo against CPU, or jump into online PvP and co-op.

apps.name: ひとりあそび
apps.short_description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

apps.name: みならい王子のみならい防衛
apps.short_description: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

apps.name: みんなでティア表!
apps.short_description: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

apps.name: クッキング赤ちゃん
apps.short_description: An adult story and minigame collection featuring Minori. Play eight challenges with clicking, sliding, rhythm, and timing controls. Build your stats, unlock new stages and scenes, and revisit the gallery. Includes difficulty options and repeat modes in supported games.

apps.name: プレア・チェスト
apps.short_description:
A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts.
A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

apps.name: ミステリ―アドベンチャー　犯人はメイド
apps.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

apps.name: レザリシアストーリーズ
